attributes.name: unspecifiedAccessoryPermitted
attributes.doc: Defines whether accessories which are not explicitly defined by a PartRelation may be used with instances of this part. If this attribute is not specified the default value is true.

attributes.name: voltageRating
attributes.doc: The voltageRating of a component indicates the maximum voltage for which the component (e.g. a fuse, connector housing,...) is designed to operate safely.

attributes.name: voltageLevelCompliance
attributes.doc: Defines the voltage levels (in terms of NominalVoltage) for which the part is approved.

attributes.name: applicationType
attributes.doc: Defines the valid application types (or fields of application) for the PartVersion described by this GeneralTechnicalPartSpecification. An application type usually implies a wide variety of aspects, s

name: HousingComponent
documentation: A HousingComponent describes the interface of an EEComponent with which it can be connected to another EEComponent or a harness. The characteristics of the interface can be described with a referenced ConnectorHousingSpecification. (see KBLFRM-300)

attributes.name: identification
attributes.doc: Identification of the HousingComponent, which must be distinct for all HousingComponents of an EEComponent.

attributes.name: description
attributes.doc: Specifies additional, human readable information about the HousingComponent .

attributes.name: compatibleTypes
attributes.doc: The values of this attribute define the HousingComponentTypes that are valid to be associated with this HousingComponent. In other word, if this HousingComponent can be associated with a relay, a fuse

name: InsulationSpecification
documentation: Specification for the definition of insulation properties of a WireElement.

attributes.name: wireType
attributes.doc: Defines the type of the insulation. A WireType is a key in a reference system for the definition of wires. Some reference systems define independent type fragments for insulations and conductors and t

attributes.name: baseColor
attributes.doc: Specifies the base color of the insulation.

attributes.name: firstIdentificationColor
attributes.doc: Specifies the first identification color of the insulation.

attributes.name: secondIdentificationColor
attributes.doc: Specifies the second identification color of the insulation.

attributes.name: labelIdentificationColor
attributes.doc: Specifies the color of a label printed on the insulation of the wire.

attributes.name: labelIdentificationType
attributes.doc: Specifies the type of a label printed, stamped or integrated on or in the insulation of the wire (e.g. alpha numerical, bar code).

attributes.name: labelIdentificationValue
attributes.doc: Specifies the value of a label printed on the insulation of the wire. This value applies to all wire elements that satisfy this specification, so all instances share the same label value (e.g. a wire

attributes.name: material
attributes.doc: Specifies the material of the insulation.

attributes.name: thickness
attributes.doc: Specifies the thickness of the insulation.

attributes.name: labelingTechnology
attributes.doc: Specifies used labeling technology if the label is already defined in this specification.

attributes.name: allowedLabelingTechnology
attributes.doc: Specifies the allowed labeling technologies if the insulation is not yet labeled, but support labeling in its usage.

name: InternalTerminalConnection
documentation: An InternalTerminalConnection represents an electrical connection within a terminal. For standard terminals all receptions (wire- and terminal-receptions) have an electrical connection. For non-standard terminals (e.g. coax) only some receptions have an electrical connection. The InternalTerminalConnection is modelled as a separate class and not as relationship between wire- and terminal-reception, since it is possible that a terminal has only one kind of reception (e.g. a parallel connector, a

attributes.name: identification
attributes.doc: Specifies a unique identification of the InternalTerminalConnection. The identification is guaranteed to be unique within the TerminalSpecification (this might be for example an internal connection nu

name: ModularSlot
documentation: A ModularSlot is a specialization of AbstractSlot . Unlike a Slot , it does not contain cavities itself but serves as a mounting location for other connector housings (modules) during assembly. This enables flexible, modular assembly and potentially reusable mating strategies.

attributes.name: optional
attributes.doc: Specifies whether the allocation of the ModularSlot is optional or not (can a usage of the connector housing leave this ModularSlot empty.

name: MultiCavityPlugSpecification
documentation: Specification for the definition of cavity plugs that apply to more than one cavity. A cavity plug is a watertight non-electrical object to fill an empty cavity. MultiCavityPlugs are formed to fit into one connector / slot and to seal more than one cavity at once. Normally there are different variants of these MultiCavityPlugs that can seal a connector in different pinning scenarios. The cavities that are plugged by a MultiCavityPlug are defined with a SealedCavitiesAssignment.

deprecated.reason: Was replaced by the more powerful concept of CablePlugs (see documentation of MultiCavitySealSpecification for a detailed explanation).

name: MultiCavitySealSpecification
documentation: Specification for cavity seals that apply to more than one cavity. A CavitySeal is a watertight non-electrical object to fill a populated Cavity. MultiCavitySeals are formed to fit into one connector / slot and to seal more than one cavity at once. There are two types of MultiCavitySeals: In first type the MultiCavitySeal has an opening for all cavities of the connector. Each opening can be filled either with a wire (without an individual seal) or with a CavityPlug (e.g. a synthetic pin) or a Mu

deprecated.reason: Was replaced by the more powerful concept of CableSeals (see documentation of MultiCavitySealSpecification) .

name: PartRelation
documentation: A PartRelation defines additional parts (e.g. accessories) for a specific part. These parts are in some way or usage scenario required for the part itself to be used. However, they are not included with the part number and have to ordered separately. This can be used for example for caps, cable ties etc. The associated PartRelations of a GeneralTechnicalPartSpecification represent a configurable bill of material that can/must be ordered together with the part, when it is used. Each PartRelation

attributes.name: relationType
attributes.doc: Specifies the type of the relation.

attributes.name: customRelationExpression
attributes.doc: Defines the relationship between the accessory parts in a proprietary expression language. This attribute shall only be used, if the relationType = 'Custom'.

name: PartRelationType
documentation: Defines how the set of acessoryParts referenced by a PartRelation should be interpreted.

name: PinApplianceType
documentation: Classifies the appliance of a Pin in terms of the duration of the appliance. E.g. the power supply pin of a power window has "shortTerm" PinApplianceType, in contrast to the head light which is a "long term".

name: PinComponent
documentation: A PinComponent describes a pin of an EEComponent. A PinComponent is part of a HousingComponent and is defined by three aspects. Its geometric position in the HousingComponent , which is defined by the referencedCavity. Its physical electrical properties, which are defined by the referenced TerminalSpecification. Its electrical behavior, which is defined configuration dependent by its PinComponentBehaviour.

attributes.name: identification
attributes.doc: Identification of the PinComponent, which must be distinct for all PinComponent of a HousingComponents.

attributes.name: description
attributes.doc: Specifies additional, human readable information about the PinComponent .

attributes.name: pinComponentType
attributes.doc: Specifies the type of a PinComponent .

name: PinCurrentInformation
documentation: Allows the definition of currents for a pin of an EEComponent. A current can be further specified by a duration. Attributes of the type PinCurrentInformation normally have the multiplicity [0..*]. This means that such an attribute can have PinCurrentInformation entries for different types and durations. It must not have multiple entries for the same type and duration.

attributes.name: type
attributes.doc: Defines the type of the current.

attributes.name: current
attributes.doc: The current of the pin.

attributes.name: determinationType
attributes.doc: Specifies the determination type of the PinCurrentInformation .

name: PinCurrentType
documentation: Defines the different available current types of a pin.

name: PinOpticalInformation
documentation: Allows the specification of optical information in a PinComponentBehavior.

attributes.name: frequency
attributes.doc: The frequency of the optical signal.

attributes.name: attenuation
attributes.doc: The attenuation of the optical pin at the defined frequency.

name: PinTiming
documentation: Specifies the timing for a PinCurrentInformation or a PinVoltageInformation .

attributes.name: type
attributes.doc: Specifies the type of the timing.

attributes.name: time
attributes.doc: Specifies the time value of the timing.

name: PinTimingType
documentation: Defines the different available timing types of a pin.

name: PinType
documentation: Defines the type of a pin.

name: PinVoltageInformation
documentation: Allows the definition of voltages for a pin of an EEComponent . A current can be further specified by a duration. Attributes of the type PinVoltageInformation normally have the multiplicity [0..*]. This means that such an attribute can have PinVoltageInformation entries for different types and durations. It must not have multiple entries for the same type and duration.

attributes.name: type
attributes.doc: Defines the type of the voltage.

attributes.name: voltage
attributes.doc: The voltage of the pin.

attributes.name: determinationType
attributes.doc: Specifies the determination type of the PinVoltageInformation .

name: PinVoltageType
documentation: Defines the different available voltage types of a pin.

name: PluggableTerminalSpecification
documentation: Specification for the definition of pluggable terminals.

attributes.name: terminalType
attributes.doc: Defines the type of the terminal. The type defines constraints about the numbers of wire and terminal receptions and their relations.

attributes.name: maximumInsertionForce
attributes.doc: The maximum force that may be applied to the terminal during the insertion process of the terminal into the housing

name: RelaySpecification
documentation: Specification of the electrological aspects of a relay.

attributes.name: iMax
attributes.doc: Specifies the maximum current allowed for the relais.

attributes.name: relaisType
attributes.doc: The type of the relay (switching behavior). This is an OpenEnumeration, for values see RelaisType.

attributes.name: lowNoise
attributes.doc: Defines if the relais switch with low noise / silently or not.

attributes.name: applianceType
attributes.doc: Specifies the appliance type of a relais.

name: RingTerminalSpecification
documentation: Specification for the definition of ring terminals. These are the counterparts to bolt terminals.

attributes.name: boltDiameter
attributes.doc: Specifies the diameter of the bolt for which the ring terminal is designed for in a numerical way.

attributes.name: boltNominalSize
attributes.doc: Defines the size (diameter) of the bolt for which the ring terminal is designed for in a nominal way (e.g. "M8").

attributes.name: thickness
attributes.doc: Specifies the thickness of the contact surface of the ring terminal.

attributes.name: boltType
attributes.doc: Specifies the type of the bolt to which the ring terminal is compatible.

attributes.name: outsideDimension
attributes.doc: Specifies the diameter of the circle around the center of the bolt which passes through the farthest outside point of the contact surface of the ring terminal.

attributes.name: torsionProtection
attributes.doc: Specifies if the ring terminal is torsion protected or not. (see KBLFRM-311)

attributes.name: nutIntegrated
attributes.doc: Defines if the ring terminal has nut integrated for the fixation on the corresponding bolt terminal.

name: SealedCavitiesAssignment
documentation: A SealedCavitiesAssignment groups the cavities of ONE connector that are sealed by a MultiCavityPlug. If a MultiCavityPlug fits into more than one connector, than there are as many SealedCavitiesAssignments .

name: SegmentConnectionPoint
documentation: Specifies a point where the connector can be attached to the topology (sometimes called bundle position point or insertion point).

attributes.name: identification
attributes.doc: Specifies a unique identification of the SegmentConnectionPoint. The identification is guaranteed to be unique within the ConnectorHousingSpecification.

name: ShieldSpecification
documentation: Specifies the properties of a shield.

attributes.name: opticalTissueDensity
attributes.doc: Defines the optical tissue density of the strands of a shield. This is defined as a value in percentage. Should only be used for ShieldSpecifications with type=Braided.

deprecated.reason: Attribute had incorrectly the data NumericalValue, a value with unit, which is not correct for a value representing a ratio. Use OpticalCoverage instead.

attributes.name: opticalCoverage
attributes.doc: Defines the optical coverage of the strands of a shield. This value is defined as the ratio of overall area to the area covered by the shield. A value of 0.0 would mean no cover at all, a value of 1.0

attributes.name: windingType
attributes.doc: Defines the type of winding of the shield. Should only be used for ShieldSpecifications with type=Foil.

name: Slot
documentation: A Slot is a specific type of AbstractSlot that represents a group of cavities integrated directly into a connector housing. The design of a slot is described by a SlotSpecification . Slots serve two primary purposes: Cavity grouping within a housing: Each slot contains or groups cavities with specific properties and geometric placement. Definition of mating-side structure : A slot represents a logical and physical mating region of a connector. This makes it a fundamental unit for modular mating.

attributes.name: colorInformation
attributes.doc: Specifies the color of the slot.

attributes.name: sealingType
attributes.doc: Specifies the type of the sealing of the slot, if sealed. The values are defined in an OpenEnumeration .

attributes.name: permittedTerminalSupplierCompanyNames
attributes.doc: If this attribute is defined, it is only permitted to use terminals of one of the listed terminal suppliers. The used company name shall be same as the one used as PartVersion.companyName for part num

name: SlotLayout
documentation: For regularly laid out slots the slot layout describes the positions of the cavities

attributes.name: gridX
attributes.doc: The horizontal distance between the center points of two cavities.

attributes.name: gridY
attributes.doc: The vertical distance between the center points of two cavities.

attributes.name: rowCount
attributes.doc: The number of cavity rows of the slot.

name: SlotSpecification
documentation: Specification for the definition of slots.

attributes.name: emvProtectionRequired
attributes.doc: Specifies whether the slot needs EMV protection.

attributes.name: gender
attributes.doc: Specifies the gender of the slot. Valid values are defined in an open enumeration.

attributes.name: layoutType
attributes.doc: Specifies the layout of the slot from a mechanical / geometrical point of view.

attributes.name: secondaryLocking
attributes.doc: Specifies whether the slot supports "secondary locking", which refers to a locking or a lock reinforcement of the terminals in the connector, in addition to the primary locking of terminal itself (e.g

attributes.name: secondaryLockingType
attributes.doc: Defines the type of the secondary locking, if the slot features a secondary locking ( secondaryLocking=true) .

attributes.name: numberOfCavities
attributes.doc: The possible number of cavities in the layout defined by the SlotSpecification. This includes all cavities in the layout. The actual Slot can define specific cavities in the layout as "not available".

outgoing_relations.doc: Specifies the layout of a slot.

name: SpliceTerminalSpecification
documentation: Specification for the definition of splice terminals.

name: TerminalCurrentInformation
documentation: Allows the definition of valid current ranges for a terminal. A current range is always defined for a coreCrossSectionArea and a nominalVoltage . Attributes of the type TerminalCurrentInformation normally have the multiplicity [0..*]. This means that such an attribute can have TerminalCurrentInformation entries for different coreCrossSectionAreas , nominalVoltages , environmentTemperature and mating terminals. It must not have multiple entries for the same values.

attributes.name: currentRange
attributes.doc: Specifies the valid current range for the terminal. It is defined as a value range, because there are terminals where minimum current is needed to avoid corrosion.

attributes.name: nominalVoltage
attributes.doc: Specifies the nominalVoltage for which the CurrentRangeInformation is valid.

attributes.name: coreCrossSectionArea
attributes.doc: Specifies the coreCrossSectionArea for which the CurrentRangeInformation is valid. The coreCrossSectionArea is a relevant information, because the thermal absorption of the core depends on the cross-s

attributes.name: environmentTemperature
attributes.doc: The environment temperature for which this maximum current value is applicable.

name: TerminalReception
documentation: A TerminalReception is the area of a terminal where the contacting with another terminal (e.g. between a connector housing and a control unit) takes place. Normally the terminal reception is placed in a cavity of a connector housing. This class represents such an area on the terminal.

attributes.name: identification
attributes.doc: Specifies a unique identification of the TerminalReception. The identification is guaranteed to be unique within the TerminalSpecification (this might be for example a reception number).

attributes.name: gender
attributes.doc: Specifies the gender of the TerminalReception. The gender is included in the TerminalReception class in order to be able to refer the same TerminalReceptionSpecification gender independent.

name: TerminalReceptionSpecification
documentation: Specification for the definition of terminal receptions. A TerminalReception is the area of a terminal where the contacting with another terminal (e.g. between a connector housing and a control unit) takes place. Normally the terminal reception is placed in a cavity of a connector housing.

deprecated.reason: Has been replaced by the more meaningful mechanism with TerminalTypes.

attributes.name: platingMaterial
attributes.doc: Specifies the plating material of the terminal reception.

attributes.name: primaryLockingType
attributes.doc: Specifies if the terminal reception has a primary locking and of what type it is.

attributes.name: pullOutForce
attributes.doc: The force that the terminal can withstand when being pulled out of the housing. Above that force, the terminal should be expected to be pulled out of the housing (destructive).

attributes.name: testingPullOutForce
attributes.doc: The force that must be applied when the terminal is pulled back out of the housing (without further movement) in order to be able to assume that the terminal is securely latched in the housing (check

attributes.name: contactRangeLength
attributes.doc: Specifies the length of the contact area (see diagram "Terminal Dimensions").

name: TerminalSpecification
documentation: Specification for the definition of terminals. A terminal can own multiple WireReceptions & TerminalReceptions.

attributes.name: voltageRange
attributes.doc: Specifies the allowed voltage range for the connector housing.

attributes.name: sealingType
attributes.doc: Defines the SealingType of the Terminal. This type always refers to the sealing of the terminal itself. However, even a terminal which is not sealable can be used in sealed locations with additional m

attributes.name: connectionALength
attributes.doc: Specifies the length of the terminal between the contact area (terminal reception) and the crimp are (wire reception, see diagram "Terminal Dimensions").

attributes.name: overallLength
attributes.doc: Specifies the overall length the terminal (see diagram "Terminal Dimensions").

attributes.name: transmissionMedium
attributes.doc: Specifies the type of the transmission medium for the terminal.

outgoing_relations.doc: Specifies valid current ranges for the terminal.

name: TerminalType
documentation: Defines the type (system) of a terminal. The type is specified by a combination of a name for the system and an optional nominalSize. In some processes the terminal type is referred as cavity system, because the system of cavities, terminals, seals, plugs and other cavity accessories must match / be compatible. However, since a terminal has only one since type and a cavity can be compatible to more than one it is named TerminalType in the VEC.

attributes.name: name
attributes.doc: Specifies the type of the cavity (e.g. MQS, DFK, ...).

attributes.name: nominalSize
attributes.doc: Specifies the nominal size of terminals that fit into the cavity. (e.g. 2x4).

name: WireElement
documentation: A WireElement specifies a WireElementSpecification in the context of a WireSpecification . This is necessary to define a unique identification of a WireElementSpecification in the context of a WireSpecification. Additionally, the WireElement serves as anchor for the instancing of a wire ( WireElementReference ) as the WireElementSpecifications are not uniquely related to a WireSpecification for reasons of reusability.

attributes.name: identification
attributes.doc: The identification of the WireElement. The identification is guaranteed to be unique within a wire and immutable. The identification is guaranteed to be the same for the same WireElement over differen

attributes.name: index
attributes.doc: The index defines an order on the WireElements that are SubWireElements of the same WireElement and that are on the same layer. If defined for an individual WireElement , the index shall be defined fo

attributes.name: layer
attributes.doc: The layer defines the layering of WireElements that are subWireElements of the same WireElement . WireElements with lower layer values are positioned further inward. If defined for an individual WireE

name: WireElementSpecification
documentation: A WireElementSpecification is the basic element to describe a wire in the VEC. A WireElementSpecification can be atomic or composed recursively out of other WireElementSpecifications. A WireElementSpecification can reference an InsulationSpecification, if it has an insulation, a CoreSpecification, if it has a core or a WireGroupSpecification if it is a grouping of other WireElementSpecifications in the Wire (e.g. a multi-core wire with twisted pairs).

attributes.name: type
attributes.doc: Defines the type of the wire. A wire must not have more than one type. This attribute allows more than one value for the reason, that the same type can be expressed in multiple reference systems.

attributes.name: minBendRadiusDynamic
attributes.doc: Specifies the minimum bend radius for wire element, if it is used in a dynamic environment, where it is bended repeatedly (e.g. in grommet of the back door). (see KLBFRM-311)

attributes.name: minBendRadiusStatic
attributes.doc: Specifies the minimum bend radius for wire element, if it is used in a static environment, where it is bended once during installation. After that it remains unchanged in its bended position during us

attributes.name: outsideDiameter
attributes.doc: Specifies the outside diameter of the WireElement.

attributes.name: suitedForDynamicUse
attributes.doc: Specifies if it is allowed to use the WireElement in a dynamic environment. (see KBLFRM-311)

attributes.name: impedance
attributes.doc: Defines the impedance of this wireElement. Typically used for WireElements that have subWireElements e.g. twisted pair or coax wires.

attributes.name: size
attributes.doc: Defines the size of a WireElement if it has not the shape of circle. If it has the shape of a circle the size is normally defined by its outside diameter.

attributes.name: validWireReceptionTypes
attributes.doc: Defines the WireReceptionTypes that are allowed for joining with the specified WireElement.

attributes.name: gridSpacing
attributes.doc: Defines the grid spacing. The grid spacing is the distance between the centers of two adjacent sub wire elements. This attribute is only valid for WireElementSpecifications that have SubWireElementSpe

attributes.name: shape
attributes.doc: Defines the shape of a WireElement. Circular wire elements are defined by their outsideDiameter, all others are defined by their size.

attributes.name: transmissionMediumType
attributes.doc: Defines the transmission medium in this wire element.

name: WireGroupSpecification
documentation: Specification for the definition of WireGroups. Wire groups are for example used for the representation of twisted pairs.

attributes.name: groupType
attributes.doc: Specifies the type of the group (e.g. twisted pair, ...).

attributes.name: lengthOfTwist
attributes.doc: Specifies the length of twist if the wire group is representing a twisted pair.

name: WireReception
documentation: A WireReception is the area of a terminal where the contacting with a wire element (e.g. by crimping) takes place. This class represents such an area on the terminal. Its description is done with a WireReceptionSpecification, which is independent from the TerminalSpecification. This allows the reuse of the specification of similar WireReception on different terminals.

attributes.name: identification
attributes.doc: Specifies a unique identification of the WireReception. The identification is guaranteed to be unique within the TerminalSpecification (this might be for example a reception number).

attributes.name: angle
attributes.doc: Specifies the angles against two planes of the connector housing a wire reception can be buckled. The planes are defined in a way, that angles of [0.0, 0.0] specify an unbuckled (regular) terminal. Th

attributes.name: rotation
attributes.doc: Defines the rotation of a WireReception relative to the TerminalReception. The rotation of the WireReception is the angle between the normal vector on base plane of the crimp area and the y-axis, whic

name: WireReceptionSpecification
documentation: Specification for the definition of wire receptions. A WireReception is the area of a terminal where the contacting with a wire element (e.g. by crimping) takes place.

attributes.name: coreCrossSectionArea
attributes.doc: Specifies a value range for cross-section areas of cores that are compatible with the wire reception. For wire receptions where a single core is attached to, this value defines the ValueRange of the c

attributes.name: insulationDisplacementLength
attributes.doc: Specifies the length of the insulation which must be stripped off to fit to this wire reception.

attributes.name: multiContact
attributes.doc: Specifies if it is possible to contact more than one core at the wire reception. If this attribute is set to true, the wire reception is allowed for more than one wire, but one wire is possible as wel

attributes.name: wireReceptionType
attributes.doc: Specifies the type of the wire reception. The WireReceptionType defines how the wire is joined with the wire reception. This attribute is defined in an OpenEnumeration. As there are terminals that sup

attributes.name: wireElementOutsideDiameter
attributes.doc: Specifies a value range for valid diameters a WireElement must have to fit to the wire reception.

attributes.name: platingMaterial
attributes.doc: Specifies the plating material of the wire reception.

attributes.name: sealable
attributes.doc: Specifies if the wire reception can be sealed. (see KBLFRM-311)

attributes.name: frontBellMouthLength
attributes.doc: Specifies the length of the front (facing the terminal reception) bell mouth of the conductor crimp (wire reception, see diagram "Terminal Dimensions").

attributes.name: conductorCrimpLength
attributes.doc: Specifies the length of the conductor crimp (wire reception, see diagram "Terminal Dimensions").

attributes.name: conductorCrimpShape
attributes.doc: The shape of the conductor crimp (e.g. F).

attributes.name: conductorCrimpLegHeight
attributes.doc: The maximum height of the legs above the normal plane of the terminal (uncrimped state).

attributes.name: rearBellMouthLength
attributes.doc: Specifies the length of the rear bell mouth of the conductor crimp (wire reception, see diagram "Terminal Dimensions").

attributes.name: crimpConnectionLength
attributes.doc: Specifies the length of the crimp area, conductor + insulation crimp (wire reception, see diagram "Terminal Dimensions").

attributes.name: insulationCrimpLength
attributes.doc: Specifies the length of the insulation crimp (wire reception, see diagram "Terminal Dimensions").

attributes.name: insulationCrimpShape
attributes.doc: The shape of the insulation crimp (e.g. O).

attributes.name: insulationCrimpLegHeight
attributes.doc: The maximum height of the legs above the normal plane of the terminal (uncrimped state).

attributes.name: cutOffTabLength
attributes.doc: Specifies the length of the cut off tab (wire reception, see diagram "Terminal Dimensions").

attributes.name: connectionBLength
attributes.doc: Specifies the length of the connection between the conductor and the insulation crimp (wire reception, see diagram "Terminal Dimensions").

attributes.name: sheetThickness
attributes.doc: The thickness of the material of terminal (metal sheet) in the crimp area.

attributes.name: wireTipProtrusion
attributes.doc: Defines the valid length range in which the protrusion of the conductor from the conductor crimp must be located.

attributes.name: crimpBarrelType
attributes.doc: The CrimpBarrelType defines the shape of the crimp barrel in its unprocessed state. When the crimp barrel is open the wire can be laid into the terminal from above. If the crimp barrel is closed the w

name: WireSpecification
documentation: Specification for the definition of a wire. This can either be a complex multicore wire or a normal single core. In the VEC a wire is defined by one WireElement, which may be composed from other WireElements.

name: WireType
documentation: Specifies a wire type. A wire type is always defined by a key value. What wire type is meant by this key value is defined by a standard reference system.

attributes.name: type
attributes.doc: Specifies the type of the wire (e.g. FLRY, NYFAZw). Valid values are defined by the wireTypeReferenceSystem.

attributes.name: referenceSystem
attributes.doc: Specifies the reference system for the wire type.

name: SlotGender
documentation: Defines the gender of a slot.

name: PinComponentBehavior
documentation: A PinComponentBehavior specifies the electrical behavior of a PinComponent. Since the behavior of a pin is configuration dependent (e.g. the software deployed on an ECU) the PinComponentBehavior inherits from ConfigurableElement. Therefore, a PinComponent can specify multiple PinComponentBehavior.

attributes.name: identification
attributes.doc: Identification of the PinComponentBehavior which identifies it from a user perspective, and which must be distinct for all PinComponentBehaviors of a PinComponent.

attributes.name: aliasId
attributes.doc: Specifies additional identifiers for the element.

attributes.name: signalDirection
attributes.doc: The direction of the signal on this pin.

attributes.name: pinType
attributes.doc: Specifies the PinType of the PinComponent .

attributes.name: applianceType
attributes.doc: Classifies the appliance of a Pin in terms of the duration of the appliance (see PinApplianceType).

attributes.name: description
attributes.doc: Specifies additional, human readable information about the PinComponentBehaviour .

name: OpenCavitiesAssignment
documentation: An OpenCavitiesAssignment groups the cavities of ONE connector that are open in a MultiCavitySeal. If a MultiCavitySeal fits into more than one connector, than there are as many OpenCavitiesAssignments.

name: PowerConsumption
documentation: Defines the power consumption of an EEComponent . An EEComponent can have multiple different PowerConsumptions e.g. standby, maximum. An EEComponent can have multiple PowerConsumptions but must not have more than one PowerConsumptions of the same type .

attributes.name: type
attributes.doc: The type of a PowerConsumption . This should be an enumeration of values defined in a conformance class.

attributes.name: value
attributes.doc: Specifies the power consumption for this type of PowerConsumption .

name: InternalComponentConnection
documentation: An InternalComponentConnection defines a conductive connection between PinComponents within an EEComponent . Such a connection can be statically permanent or dynamically switch (e.g. by a relais). This behavior can be defined with a SwitchingState . The electrical behavior of an InternalComponentConnection can be further specified by a referenced ConductorSpecification.

attributes.name: identification
attributes.doc: Identification of the InternalComponentConnection , which must be distinct for all InternalComponentConnection of an EEComponent .

deprecated.reason: The InternalComponentConnection has been replaced with the more generic approach of adding a ConnectionSpecification to a E/E component description (see "Internal Connectivity").

name: SwitchingState
documentation: A SwitchingState defines a certain static state of an EEComponent . Under which conditions or when such a state applies, should be described in an external description model. A SwitchingState references a collection of InternalComponentConnections , with the semantic that these connections exist (and only these connections) when the switching state is active.

attributes.name: identification
attributes.doc: Identification of the SwitchingState, which must be distinct for all SwitchingStates of an EEComponent.

name: ExtensionSlot
documentation: An ExtensionSlot defines a slot within an EE-Component where other EE-Components can be plugged into (modular extension). This is necessary for example for modular power distributions.

attributes.name: identification
attributes.doc: Identification of the ExtensionSlot, which must be distinct for all ExtensionSlots of an EEComponent.

name: PinComponentType
documentation: Specifies the type of a PinComponent .

name: RelaisApplianceType
documentation: Specifies the appliance type of a relais.

name: RelaisType
documentation: Defines the type of a relais (switching behavior).

name: ModularSlotAddOn
documentation: Specifies the wire addon needed to reach a ModularSlot from a specific SegmentConnectionPoint . The addon needed to reach the cavities of the insert(s) from this point is defined by the ConnectorHousingSpecification of the insert.

attributes.name: wireAddOn
attributes.doc: Specifies the wire length add on needed for the modular slot.

name: CavityAddOn
documentation: Specifies the wire addon needed to reach a Cavity from a specific SegmentConnectionPoint . More specifically, it is the addon required to calculate the cutting length of a wire. It is not a measured distance between the segment connection point and the insertion point of the cavity. For each SegmentConnectionPoint there shall be no more than one add-on value per cavity and type.

attributes.name: wireAddOn
attributes.doc: Specifies the wire length add on needed for the cavity.

attributes.name: type
attributes.doc: Defines the type of the add-on (see CavityAddOn ).

name: ConnectorHousingCapSpecification
documentation: Specification for the definition of caps (backshells) of connectors. Different caps can add additional wire length addons to a connector housing. A 'cap' which already defines the number of cavities, coding etc. is in the VEC defined by ConnectorHousingSpecification with ModularSlots and not by a ConnectorHousingCapSpecification .

attributes.name: wireAddOn
attributes.doc: Specifies the wire length add on needed for the cap.

attributes.name: outletDirection
attributes.doc: Defines the OutletDirection for wires. This attribute is defined as an OpenEnumeration .

attributes.name: fuseType
attributes.doc: Defines the manufacturing types of a multi-fuse.

attributes.name: iMaxTotal
attributes.doc: Specifies the maximum electric current tolerated by the multi-fuse in total.

attributes.name: identification
attributes.doc: Identification of the FuseComponent, which must be distinct for all FuseComponents of an MultiFuseSpecification.

deprecated.reason: The FuseComponent was a very specific model element for internal connectivity and has been replaced with the more generic approach of adding a ConnectionSpecification to a E/E component description (see "Internal Connectivity").

name: WireReceptionType
documentation: The WireReceptionType defines in an OpenEnumeration how a wire is joined with a wire reception.

name: SlotSealingType
documentation: Defines the possible sealing types for a slot, if the slot shall be sealed in its usage.

name: ConnectorOutletDirection
documentation: Defines the OutletDirection of a connector for wires.

name: ConductorMaterial
documentation: ConductorMaterial is a helper class to specify validConductorMaterials. This is necessary, since all attributes of the type Material have a multiplicity of * with the semantics that it always defines one Material with the possibility to define it in different reference systems. Since a wire reception can have more than one validConductorMaterial this container class is necessary to keep the semantics clear.

attributes.name: material
attributes.doc: Specifies the material.

name: CavityPartSpecification
documentation: The CavityPartSpecification is an abstract class for common properties of non-electrical parts that are used in Cavities .

attributes.name: cavityDimension
attributes.doc: Specifies a valid cavity dimension to which the cavity part fits. The dimension defines the size of the sealing area of the cavity (crimp end), not in the contacting area (box end). Note: CavityDimens

attributes.name: hardness
attributes.doc: Specifies the hardness of the cavity seal.

attributes.name: geometry
attributes.doc: Defines the geometry of the cavity sealing. This attribute is defined as an OpenEnumeration.

attributes.name: compatibleTerminalType
attributes.doc: Defines a list of terminal types that are compatible to this CavitySealSpecification. This defines the compatible cavities as well, since a plug is normally used when no terminals are present.

attributes.name: compatibleCavityGeometry
attributes.doc: Defines a list of CavityGeometries that are compatible with this cavity part.

name: SealingGeometry
documentation: Defines valid values of the geometry of a cavity sealing. It defines the cross-section geometry.

name: TerminalSealingType
documentation: Defines the possible sealing types for a terminal, if the terminal shall be sealed in its usage.

name: FlatCoreSpecification
documentation: Defines the properties of a flat (rectangular) conductor which are specific for them.

attributes.name: size
attributes.doc: Defines the size (width & height) of the flat core.

name: WireElementShape
documentation: Defines the shape of a wire element.

name: PrimaryLockingType
documentation: Defines the valid primary locking types for terminals.

name: PluggableTerminalType
documentation: Defines valid values for the type of PluggableTerminals. The type defines constraints about the numbers of wire and terminal receptions and their relations.

name: WireEndAccessorySpecification
documentation: WireEndAccessorySpecifications are describing parts that are used for a treatment of a wire end before the actual terminal is attached to the WireEnd (e.g. a ferrule). The actual specification of the properties of the wire end accessory is done by the referenced WireReceptionSpecification since this is the Specification to describe joining properties of a part with a wire end.

name: CavityAccessorySpecification
documentation: A CavityAccessory is a non-electrical part used in a cavity with no sealing properties (e.g. a wire fixation).

attributes.name: wireElementOutsideDiameter
attributes.doc: Specifies a range of valid wire diameters to which the cavity accessory fits.

attributes.name: wireReceptionType
attributes.doc: Specifies the wireReceptionType to which the cavity accessory fits.

name: PotentialDistributorSpecification
documentation: Specifies the properties of a potential distributor (e.g. a joint connector).

attributes.name: screwable
attributes.doc: Defines if the PotentialDistributor can be screwed by itself to be fixed. This fixation is a non-electrical connection. If the PotentialDistributor can be fixated electrical (like a ring terminal) it

attributes.name: boltDiameter
attributes.doc: Specifies the diameter of the bolt for which the potential distributor is designed for.

attributes.name: boltNominalSize
attributes.doc: Defines the size (diameter) of the bolt for which the potential distributor is designed for in a nominal way (e.g. "M8").

attributes.name: boltType
attributes.doc: Specifies the type of the bolt to which the potential distributor is compatible.

name: HousingComponentType
documentation: Defines the valid HousingComponentTypes. The values in this Enumeration are matching the relevant PrimaryPartTypes. For a description of the values see PrimaryPartType.

name: FuseType
documentation: Defines the values for the type a fuse. This is the geometrical type.

name: BoltTerminalSpecification
documentation: Specification for the definition of bolt terminals. These are the counterparts to ring terminals.

attributes.name: boltDiameter
attributes.doc: Specifies the diameter of the bolt in a numerical way.

attributes.name: boltHeight
attributes.doc: Specifies the height of the bolt (the height of the part to which ring terminals can be attached).

attributes.name: boltNominalSize
attributes.doc: Defines the size (diameter) of the bolt in a nominal way (e.g. "M8").

attributes.name: boltType
attributes.doc: Specifies the type of the bolt.

attributes.name: torsionProtection
attributes.doc: Specifies if the bolt provides torsion protected or not.

attributes.name: maxTerminalCount
attributes.doc: Defines the maximum number of (ring) terminals that can be attached to this bolt at the same time.

name: WireAddOnType
documentation: Specifies possible values for the t ype of wire add-ons (e.g. CavityAddOn ).

name: DiodeSpecification
documentation: Specification of the electrological aspects of a diode.

attributes.name: thresholdVoltage
attributes.doc: Voltage at which the diode starts conducting in forward direction.

attributes.name: breakDownVoltage
attributes.doc: Voltage at which the diode starts conducting in reverse direction.

attributes.name: iMax
attributes.doc: Specifies the maximum electric current tolerated by the diode.

name: CapacitorSpecification
documentation: Specification of the electrological aspects of a capacitor.

attributes.name: uMax
attributes.doc: The breakdown voltage of the capacitor.

name: OpenWireEndTerminalSpecification
documentation: Specification for the definition of open wire ends. An open wire end is an end of wire located at a specific location in the harness. Open wire ends are not connected to some other component, in contrast to regular connectors or ring terminals. Only one wire is ending at a single open wire end, otherwise it would be a splice.

name: WireReceptionAddOn
documentation: Specifies the wire addon required for this wire reception.

attributes.name: wireAddOn
attributes.doc: Specifies the wire length add on needed for the wire reception.

attributes.name: type
attributes.doc: Defines the type of the add-on.

name: CavityGeometry
documentation: Defines valid values of the geometry of cavities in the sealing area (crimp end).

name: BridgeTerminalSpecification
documentation: A bridge terminal is a part that behaves like terminal but has no WireReceptions. It is used to create short circuit between different pins in a connector. In its use, it can realize a schematic connection on its own and independently of other components.

name: CavityPositionDetail
documentation: CavityPositionDetail is an aggregator class for all geometric properties of a cavity within the connector (e.g. rotation, position).

attributes.name: rotation
attributes.doc: The rotation of the cavity is defined as the angle between the primary locking of the cavity and the Y-axis of the connector housing coordinate system.

attributes.name: cavitySealingOffset
attributes.doc: Defines the offset (length) by which the starting point of the sealing area is displaced insertionPosition in insertion direction.

attributes.name: insertionDepth
attributes.doc: The insertionDepth of a cavity is the length of the insertion path for a terminal. The distance a terminal must travel from the InsertionPosition to its final position.

name: FoilShieldWindingType
documentation: Defines the type of winding for foil shields. It can be folded around and along the inner wire elements like a cigarette paper or it can be wound around them in a spiral. Both types result in different manufacturing and EMC properties.

name: ConductorType
documentation: Specifies the type of the conductor, e.g. if it is rigid or stranded.

name: ConductorStructure
documentation: Specifies the structure of the conductor according to ISO 6722-1 for ConductorSpecifications with Type = Stranded.

name: TransmissionMediumType
documentation: OpenEnumeration of the different transmission mediums in wire elements.

name: TerminalBoltType
documentation: Open Enumeration to define different types of bolts for bolt / ring terminals.

name: TerminalBoltNominalSize
documentation: Defines the nominal sizes for threaded bolts as "ISO metric screw thread" or as "Unified Thread Standard" (Imperial). See also TerminalBoltType.MetricThread / ImperialThread. For the definition of the values see https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/ISO_metric_screw_thread and https://de.wikipedia.org/wiki/Unified_Thread_Standard .

name: GrommetMountingType
documentation: OpenEnumeration to define different mounting possibilities of a grommet onto a wiring harness.

name: LabelType
documentation: OpenEnumeration of different labeling types. This refers to the way the information is encoded.

name: MultiFuseType
documentation: OpenEnumeration for the manufacturing types of the multi-fuses.

name: LabelingTechnology
documentation: OpenEnumeration of standard labeling technologies.

name: WireGroupType
documentation: OpenEnumeration for the types of wire groups.

name: SegmentConnectionPointHC
documentation: Specifies a point where the HousingComponent can be attached to the topology [if required] (sometimes called bundle position point or insertion point). Note: The suffix HC is justified by the fact that class names must be unique within the model and the name SegmentConnectionPoint is already used within the ConnectorHousingSpecification. However, the represented semantics of the two connection points are so similar that the use of actually different names for both would rather have led to confus

attributes.name: wireAddOn
attributes.doc: Defines the wire add-on that is required the reach the referenced SegmentConnectionPoint from this SegmentConnectionPointHC with which the individual cavity add-ons are defined.

name: SlotLayoutType
documentation: OpenEnumeration that defines standard slot layouts. A slot layout represents the mechanical / geometrical properties / layout of the slot, not the electrical properties.

name: WireTupleSpecification
documentation: A Specification to define requirements for the handling of wire / wire element tuples (pairs, triple,...) with the focus on twisting. More precisely, the allowed untwisting at the wire ends and required measures against it. This definition is made independent from the WireGroup , as it might be defined for the part master data (the wire on the roller). The specifications for untwisting are based on the concrete usage.

attributes.name: fixationRequired
attributes.doc: Specifies if an implementation of this specification in a concrete harness required to define a fixation against untwisting of the wire ends.

attributes.name: fixationOffset
attributes.doc: The offset from the wire end, at which the fixation has to be placed.

attributes.name: maximumUntwistSingleSided
attributes.doc: Specifies the maximum untwist for one side.

attributes.name: maximumUntwistDualSided
attributes.doc: Specifies the maximum untwist for both sides together (A+B).

name: PowerConsumptionType
documentation: OpenEnumeration for predefined PowerConsumptionTypes.

name: LabelingSpecification
documentation: A component (of any type) can labeled in many ways either during the manufacturing process, for example a label that is imprinted on the component during the general manufacturing process (e.g. the part number), or in its concrete use (e.g. with wire number or a usage node id). The LabelingSpecification defines general labeling properties of the component. Labeling properties in its concrete use are defined with the corresponding role.

attributes.name: labelType
attributes.doc: Specifies the type of a label printed, stamped or integrated on or in component (e.g. alpha numerical, bar code).

attributes.name: labelValue
attributes.doc: Specifies the value of a label printed on the component. This value applies to all components that satisfy this specification, so all instances share the same label value (e.g. a part number). If inst

attributes.name: labelingTechnology
attributes.doc: Specifies the used labeling technology if the label is already defined in this specification.

attributes.name: allowedLabelingTechnology
attributes.doc: Specifies the allowed labeling technologies if the component is not yet labeled, but support labeling in its usage.

name: TerminalReceptionGender
documentation: OpenEnumeration of possible genders for TerminalReception

name: TerminalDistanceInformation
documentation: Allows the definition of valid minimum distances for a terminal. A minimum distance is always a NumericalValue defined for a TerminalDistanceType . Attributes of the type TerminalDistanceInformation normally have the multiplicity [0..*]. This means that such an attribute can have TerminalDistanceInformation entries for different TerminalDistanceType . It must not have multiple entries for the same TerminalDistanceType .

attributes.name: type
attributes.doc: The type of the TerminalDistanceInformation.

attributes.name: value
attributes.doc: Defines the valid minimum distance.

name: TerminalDistanceType
documentation: OpenEnumeration of possible TerminalDistanceTypes for TerminalDistanceInformation .

name: HoleTerminalSpecification
documentation: Specification for the definition of hole terminals. These are used for example as attachment points of ring terminals at the car body.

attributes.name: holeDiameter
attributes.doc: Specifies the diameter of the hole in a numerical way.

attributes.name: holeDepth
attributes.doc: Specifies the depth of the hole.

attributes.name: holeNominalSize
attributes.doc: Defines the size (diameter) of the hole in a nominal way (e.g. "M8").

attributes.name: holeType
attributes.doc: Specifies the type of the hole.

attributes.name: torsionProtection
attributes.doc: Specifies if the hole provides torsion protected or not.

attributes.name: maxTerminalCount
attributes.doc: Defines the maximum number of (ring) terminals that can be attached to this hole at the same time.

name: InsulationCrimpDetail
documentation: The InsulationCrimpDetail defines crimp values for an insulation crimp. The selection criteria to which the InsulationCrimpDetail applies are defined by the referenced InsulationSpecification and the ConductorSpecification referenced by the containing CoreCrimpDetail.

attributes.name: pullOffForce
attributes.doc: The minimum force that the completed crimp should withstand when wire is being pulled off the terminal. Above that force, the crimp can be expected to be destroyed at any time. This value applies when

attributes.name: insulationPullOffForce
attributes.doc: The minimum force that the completed crimp should withstand when wire is being pulled off the terminal. Above that force, the crimp can be expected to be destroyed at any time. This value applies when

name: CoreCrimpDetail
documentation: The CoreCrimpDetail defines crimp values for a conductor crimp (wire crimp). The selection criteria to which the CoreCrimpDetail applies are defined by the referenced ConductorSpecification.

attributes.name: corePullOffForce
attributes.doc: The minimum force that the completed crimp should withstand when wire is being pulled off the terminal. Above that force, the crimp can be expected to be destroyed at any time. This value applies when

name: CrimpDetail
documentation: Abstract base class for the definition of CrimpDetail- information. See CoreCrimpDetail & InsulationCrimpDetail .

attributes.name: size
attributes.doc: Defines the expected size of the crimp. The height is measured in direction of the crimp opening. The width is measured in orthogonal to the height and orthogonal to main axis of the terminal ( Termin

name: CrimpShape
documentation: OpenEnumeration of possible CrimpShapes for Core- and InsulationCrimps.

name: SecondaryLockingType
documentation: Defines the valid secondary locking types within slots (syn. Terminal Position Assurance).

name: ConnectorLockingType
documentation: Defines the valid primary locking types for connectors.

name: ConnectorPositionAssuranceType
documentation: Defines the valid connector position assurance types for connectors.

name: ConnectorHousingCoverSpecification
documentation: Specification for the definition of covers for connectors. A ConnectorHousingCover is used to protect the contacting side (front) of the connector during transport of the harness or in the vehicle, if the connector remains unconnected (e.g. in case of "give-away" features or retrofit options). There are two types of covers, on the one hand components whose sole purpose is to be used as a cover and on the other hand normal harness connectors which can also be used as covers, if necessary sealed w

name: ApplicationType
documentation: OpenEnumeration defines different fields of application / application types for and within wiring harnesses. For definitions of 12V to HV5 see NominalVoltage.

name: CoatingSpecification
documentation: A CoatingSpecification is a special WireEndAccessorySpecifications are describing parts / procedures with which the wire end is treated before the actual terminal is attached to the WireEnd (e.g. a tin coating of the wire end). Properties of the procedure are defined by the referenced WireReceptionSpecification , e.g. the coating material is defined by the GeneralTechnicalPartSpecification.MaterialInformation .

name: TerminalProtectionSpecification
documentation: A TerminalProtection is an insulation or sealing that is applied after the joining process between the terminal and the wire, typically in the contact area of the WireReception. Examples include caps for splices or heat shrink tubing for ring terminals.

attributes.name: insideLength
attributes.doc: The length on the inside of the terminal protection. For a splice cap, for example, this is the measurement how far wires can be inserted.

attributes.name: insideDiameter
attributes.doc: The inside diameter of the terminal protection.

attributes.name: outsideLength
attributes.doc: The length of the terminal protection on the outside.

attributes.name: outsideDiameter
attributes.doc: The outside diameter of the terminal protection.

attributes.name: wallThickness
attributes.doc: The wall thickness of the terminal protection. Usually, this should be (outsideDiameter - insideDiameter) / 2.

attributes.name: shrinkable
attributes.doc: Specifies if the terminal protection is heat shrinkable.

attributes.name: shrinkingFactor
attributes.doc: Defines the factor of shrinking for the terminal protection.

attributes.name: maximumLongitudinalShrinkage
attributes.doc: Defines the shrinkage in longitudinal direction.

attributes.name: adhesivePresent
attributes.doc: Defines if an adhesive / sealing is already present in the terminal protection.

attributes.name: adhesive
attributes.doc: Defines the material used as adhesive / sealing, if present.

name: CrimpBarrelType
documentation: The CrimpBarrel Type defines in an OpenEnumeration the shape of the crimp barrel in its unprocessed state.

name: ReferenceSurfaceDefinition
documentation: A connector housing can define reference surfaces that serve as contact surfaces in a work piece holder. Those reference surfaces normally have defined tolerance limits to support accurate determination of cavity positions for example during the insertion process.

attributes.name: hasSurfaces
attributes.doc: Specifies whether the connector has defined references surfaces or not.

attributes.name: dimensionX
attributes.doc: Specifies the distance and tolerance between the middle axis of the lowest alpha numerical cavity (origin of the connector coordinate system) and the reference surface in direction of the X-axis.

attributes.name: dimensionY
attributes.doc: Specifies the distance and tolerance between the middle axis of the lowest alpha numerical cavity (origin of the connector coordinate system) and the reference surface in direction of the X-axis.

name: CavityLayout
documentation: A CavityLayout represents a specific configuration pattern for a component with cavities. It defines a set of virtualCavities that serve as placeholders for the actual cavities provided by component that satisfies this layout (e.g. a contact module). It acts as a structural template, such as single-pole, five-pole, or multi-row configurations, that allows the definition of properties (e.g. a cavity mapping) for all components that satisfy this layout, instead of specifying those for each compone

attributes.name: identification
attributes.doc: Specifies a unique identification of the ModularSlotLayout . The identification is guaranteed to be unique within the ModularSlot .

name: ModularSlotConfiguration
documentation: A ModularSlotConfiguration defines a valid combination of ModularSlotLayouts for a set of modular slots within a connector housing. This class enables the modeling of complex interdependencies between modular slots—particularly when the validity of one layout depends on the configuration of other slots. It is essential for ensuring consistency in use cases requiring continuous cavity numbering or where spatial constraints affect insert placement.

attributes.name: identification
attributes.doc: Specifies a unique identification of the ModularSlotConfiguration . The identification is guaranteed to be unique within the ConnectorHousingSpecification.

name: FuseCharacteristic
documentation: The FuseCharacteristic specializes the MultiDimensionalValue for describing fuse behavior. It references two mandatory d imension s: one for current (I) and one for tripping time (T). Additional dimensions may be included as needed (e.g., temperature).

name: CableSealPlugSpecification
documentation: A cable seal plug is a plug that is used to seal entries of a cable seal. A cable seal plug can seal multiple CableSealEntry at the same time. A cable seal plug can have additional feature/functions at the same time. For example, it might also serve as a seal retainer in connector housing.

name: CableSealSpecification
documentation: Specification for seals that are associated with one or more wires and not with specific cavity or crimp. A CavitySeal is a watertight non-electrical object to fill a populated Cavity. Cable seals are designed to seals specific areas (covering one or more wires) in a connector or a grommet. A cable seal is used on a cable outside the crimp. A CableSealSpecification defines one or more CableSealEntries. Cable seals can have more than one entry with different wire sizes. There are two variants of

name: CableSealEntry
documentation: Specifies an opening in the cable seal.

attributes.name: identification
attributes.doc: Provides an identifier for the CableSealEntry . The Identification shall be unique within a CableSealSpecification.

attributes.name: wireElementOutsideDiameter
attributes.doc: Specifies a range of valid wire diameters to which the CableSealEntry fits.

attributes.name: insideDiameter
attributes.doc: Defines the inside diameter in the relaxed state for the opening in the cable seal.

name: SealingPin
documentation: Specifies a pin to seal a CableSealEntry.

attributes.name: identification
attributes.doc: Provides an identifier for the SealingPin . The Identification shall be unique within a CableSealPlugSpecification.

attributes.name: outsideDiameter
attributes.doc: Defines the outside diameter in the relaxed state for the SealingPin .

name: ExternalMapping
documentation: An ExternalMapping is used to relate an ExtendableElement in the VEC with an element located in an external data source. The element in the VEC is referenced by the mappedElement , the external element is identified by the attribute externalReference.

attributes.name: externalReference
attributes.doc: Defines the unique key of the external element. How this key shall be interpreted is dependent from the format of the external data source.

name: ExternalMappingSpecification
documentation: An ExternalMappingSpecification is used to define a mapping between an external data source (represented by the referenced mappedDocument ) and the content of a VEC file.

name: BuildingBlockPositioning2D
documentation: Defines the position of a BuildingBlock2D on a HarnessDrawing.

attributes.name: identification
attributes.doc: Specifies a unique (optional) identification of the BuildingBlockPositioning2D. The identification is guaranteed to be unique within the HarnessDrawingSpecification2D.

name: BuildingBlockSpecification2D
documentation: Specification for the description of a two-dimensional building block. A building block is a reusable section of a geometry.

name: CartesianDimension
documentation: The CartesianDimension specifies the size of an object in 2D-space.

attributes.name: height
attributes.doc: Specifies the height of the object. The unit of this value is the baseUnit of containing BuildingBlockSpecification2D.

attributes.name: width
attributes.doc: Specifies the width of the object. The unit of this value is the baseUnit of containing BuildingBlockSpecification2D.

name: CartesianPoint2D
documentation: A CartesianPoint2D is a point that is defined by its coordinates in a rectangular two-dimensional Cartesian coordinate system.

attributes.name: x
attributes.doc: Specifies the value of x-coordinate of the Cartesian point. The unit of this value is the baseUnit of containing BuildingBlockSpecification2D.

attributes.name: y
attributes.doc: Specifies the value of y-coordinate of the Cartesian point. The unit of this value is the baseUnit of containing BuildingBlockSpecification2D.

name: CartesianVector2D
documentation: A Cartesian vector in the two-dimensional space.

attributes.name: x
attributes.doc: Specifies the x-coordinate in 2D space.

attributes.name: y
attributes.doc: Specifies the y-coordinate in 2D space.

name: GeometryNode2D
documentation: A GeometryNode2D is the geometric representation of a TopologyNode in 2D-space.

name: GeometrySegment2D
documentation: A GeometrySegment2D is the geometric representation of a TopologySegment in 2D-space.

attributes.name: startVector
attributes.doc: Specifies the start vector of the geometry segment. The start vector is a tangent to the segment at the start position.

attributes.name: endVector
attributes.doc: Specifies the end vector of the geometry segment. The end vector is a tangent to the segment at the end position.

name: HarnessDrawingSpecification2D
documentation: The HarnessDrawingSpecification2D specifies a two-dimensional drawing of a harness. A harness drawing is composed of one or more BuildingBlockSpecifaction2D which are placed on the drawing.

name: OccurrenceOrUsageViewItem2D
documentation: An OccurrenceOrUsageViewItem2D specifies the representation of an OccurrenceOrUsage in a 2DDrawing.

attributes.name: identification
attributes.doc: Specifies a unique identification of the OccurrenceOrUsageViewItem2D. The identification is guaranteed to be unique within the BuildingBlockSpecification2D.

attributes.name: aliasId
attributes.doc: Specifies additional identifiers for the OccurrenceOrUsageViewItem2D.

attributes.name: gridSquare
attributes.doc: Specifies the grid square in which the OccurrenceOrUsageViewItem2D is placed (e.g. E/40).

name: PathSegment
documentation: A PathSegment is a part of the 2D presentation of a GeometrySegment2D. The complete presentation of a GeometrySegment2D is built from an ordered list of PathSegments. Each PathSegment has an ordered list of control points through which the path goes. If no curveRadius is specified the control points are connected by a direct straight line. If a curveRadius is specified, the PathSegment can be drawn by a segment of a circle which touches all control points and has the radius specified.

attributes.name: curveRadius
attributes.doc: The radius of the curve which describes the appearance of the path segment.

name: Transformation2D
documentation: A Transformation2D is used to position an object in 2D space (e.g. on a drawing). It consists of a reference to a CartesianPoint2D as origin and a 2 ⨯ 2 matrix a . The matrix is given by the attributes [ a11 ... a22 ] , with the numbers representing the index of the matrix element a ij where i is the row and j the column index of the matrix. To place an object with a Transformation2D its origin is translated in space to the CartesianPoint2D origin and every point P = (x,y) of the object is trans

name: BuildingBlockPositioning3D
documentation: Defines the position of a BuildingBlock3D in the HarnessGeometry.

attributes.name: identification
attributes.doc: Specifies a unique (optional) identification of the BuildingBlockPositioning3D. The identification is guaranteed to be unique within the HarnessGeometrySpecification3D.

name: BuildingBlockSpecification3D
documentation: Specification for the description of a three-dimensional building block. A building block is a reusable section of a geometry.

name: CartesianPoint3D
documentation: A CartesianPoint3D is a point that is defined by its coordinates in a rectangular three-dimensional Cartesian coordinate system.

attributes.name: x
attributes.doc: Specifies the value of x-coordinate of the Cartesian point. The unit of this value is the baseUnit of containing BuildingBlockSpecification3D.

attributes.name: y
attributes.doc: Specifies the value of y-coordinate of the Cartesian point. The unit of this value is the baseUnit of containing BuildingBlockSpecification3D.

attributes.name: z
attributes.doc: Specifies the value of z-coordinate of the Cartesian point. The unit of this value is the baseUnit of containing BuildingBlockSpecification3D.

name: CartesianVector3D
documentation: A Cartesian vector in three-dimensional space.

attributes.name: x
attributes.doc: Specifies the x-coordinate in 3D space.

attributes.name: y
attributes.doc: Specifies the y-coordinate in 3D space.

attributes.name: z
attributes.doc: Specifies the z-coordinate in 3D space.

name: GeometryNode3D
documentation: A GeometryNode3D is the geometric representation of a TopologyNode in 3D-space.

name: GeometrySegment3D
documentation: A GeometrySegment3D is the geometric representation of a TopologySegment in 3D-space.

attributes.name: startVector
attributes.doc: Specifies the start vector of the geometry segment. The start vector is a tangent to the segment at the start position.

attributes.name: endVector
attributes.doc: Specifies the end vector of the geometry segment. The end vector is a tangent to the segment at the end position.

name: GeometryType
documentation: Enumeration for the definition of the GeometryType.

name: HarnessGeometrySpecification3D
documentation: The HarnessGeometrieSpecification3D specifies a three-dimensional model of a harness. A harness model is composed of one or more BuildingBlockSpecifaction3D which are placed in the model.

attributes.name: type
attributes.doc: Specifies the type of the harness geometry.

name: OccurrenceOrUsageViewItem3D
documentation: An OccurrenceOrUsageViewItem3D specifies the existence and representation of an OccurrenceOrUsage in a 3D-model. The definition of the existence is necessary because a 150% model of a harness might contain different geometric variants and not all of them must be represented in the same BuildingBlockSpecification3D . There are two different cases for the representation of OccurrenceOrUsage s in a 3D model. There are components that can be represented explicitly by a 3D model of the component (e.g

attributes.name: identification

attributes.name: aliasId
attributes.doc: Specifies additional identifiers for the OccurrenceOrUsageViewItem3D.

name: Transformation3D
documentation: A Transformation3D is used to position an object in 3D space (e.g. on a DMU model). It consists of a reference to a CartesianPoint3D as origin and a 3 ⨯ 3 matrix a . The matrix is given by the attributes [ a11 ... a33 ] , with the numbers representing the index of the matrix element a ij where i is the row and j the column index of the matrix. name: Curve3D
documentation: The Curve3D is an abstract representation of a curve, which defines the three-dimensional appearance of the centerline of a segment. The concrete type of the curve (e.g. NURBSCurve) defines the mathematical function that applies to curve and stores the required parameter set for this function in the VEC.

name: NURBSCurve
documentation: The NURBSCurve represents the parameter set of a NURBS (Non-Uniform rational B-Spline) in the VEC. attributes.doc: Defines the degree of the NURBS (for details see the class description of NURBSCurve).

attributes.name: knots
attributes.doc: Defines the knot-vector of the NURBS(for details see the class description of NURBSCurve).

name: NURBSControlPoint
documentation: Represents a control point of a NURBSCurve. It consists of a referenced CartesianPoint3D for the position and a weight .

attributes.name: weight
attributes.doc: The weight of the NURBSControlPoint.

name: OccurrenceOrUsage
documentation: An OccurrenceOrUsage is an abstract appearance of a part in the harness. This can either be a concrete part (with a part number or something similar) or the description (specification / requirements) of a part that should be used at that position. In the first case it would be a PartOccurrence in the second case a PartUsage.

attributes.doc: Specifies a unique identification of the OccurrenceOrUsage . The identification is guaranteed to be unique within the context. For all VEC-documents an OccurrenceOrUsage -instance can be trusted to be

attributes.name: aliasId
attributes.doc: Room to specify additional identifiers for the OccurrenceOrUsage .

attributes.name: abbreviation
attributes.doc: Specifies an abbreviation of the OccurrenceOrUsage . Normally this a human readable short name.

attributes.name: description
attributes.doc: Specifies additional, human readable information about the OccurrenceOrUsage .

attributes.name: quantity
attributes.doc: Specifies the actual amount of material consumed by this OccurrenceOrUsage . Allows modelling in arbitrary units (e.g. grams, centimetres, piece). If omitted the default is 1 piece. Use whenever the O

name: PartWithSubComponentsRole
documentation: A PartWithSubComponentsRole defines the instance specific properties and relationships of a part with subcomponents. A PartWithSubComponents is a composite part like an Assembly, a Module, Harness.

name: Role
documentation: A Role is the corresponding mechanism for OccurrenceOrUsages to the PartOrUsageRelatedSpecifcations for PartVersions or PartUsages. The PartOrUsageRelatedSpecifcations are describing a certain aspect of the master data of a part. A Role describes the corresponding properties and relationships for instances of a part (e.g. the usage specific properties of a wire occurrence like the length or the contacting).

attributes.name: identification
attributes.doc: Specifies a unique identification of the Role. The identification is guaranteed to be unique within the OccurrenceOrUsage.

name: SpecificRole
documentation: A SpecificRole is the possibility to define instance specific properties with custom properties (see ExtendableElement ). This is necessary, if the part is described by custom properties of a PartOrUsageRelatedSpecification .

attributes.name: specificRoleType
attributes.doc: Specifies the type for role.

name: AbstractSlotReference
documentation: An AbstractSlotReference represents the usage of an AbstractSlot in the context of PartUsage or PartOccurrence.

attributes.name: identification
attributes.doc: Specifies a unique identification of the SlotReference. The identification is guaranteed to be unique within the ConnectorHousingRole. The cavity & slot number is defined by the associated cavity and

name: CavityPlugRole
documentation: A CavityPlugRole defines the instance specific properties and relationships of a cavity plug.

name: CavityReference
documentation: A CavityReference represents the usage of a Cavity in the context of PartUsage or PartOccurrence.

attributes.name: identification
attributes.doc: Specifies a unique identification of the CavityReference. The identification is guaranteed to be unique within the ConnectorHousingRole. The cavity & slot number is defined by the associated cavity an

name: CavitySealRole
documentation: A CavitySealRole defines the instance specific properties and relationships of a cavity seal.

name: ConnectorHousingRole
documentation: A ConnectorHousingRole defines the instance specific properties and relationships of a connector housing.

attributes.name: sealState
attributes.doc: Specifies if this instance of a connector housing should be sealed (waterproof).

attributes.name: cpaState
attributes.doc: The state of the connector position assurance (CPA), if applicable. This is the state of the connector in the integration level described by the model to which the ConnectorHousingRole belongs. For ex

attributes.name: lockingState
attributes.doc: The state of the primary locking mechanism of the connector, if applicable. This is the state of the connector in the integration level described by the model to which the ConnectorHousingRole belongs

name: EEComponentRole
documentation: An EEComponentRole defines the instance specific properties and relationships of an EE-component.

name: HousingComponentReference
documentation: A HousingComponentReference represents the usage of a HousingComponent in the context of a PartUsage or PartOccurrence. (KBLFRM-401)

attributes.name: identification
attributes.doc: Specifies a unique identification of the HousingComponentReference. The identification is guaranteed to be unique within the EEComponentRole.

name: InsulationState
documentation: Enumeration for the definition of the insulation state of the splice.

name: ModularSlotReference
documentation: A ModularSlotReference represents the usage of a ModularSlot in the context of PartUsage or PartOccurrence.

name: PinComponentReference
documentation: A PinComponentReference represents the usage of a PinComponent in the context of a PartUsage or PartOccurrence. (KBLFRM-401)

attributes.name: identification
attributes.doc: Specifies a unique identification of the PinComponentReference. The identification is guaranteed to be unique within the HousingComponentReference.

name: PluggableTerminalRole
documentation: A PluggableTerminalRole defines the instance specific properties and relationships of a pluggable terminal.

name: RingTerminalRole
documentation: A RingTerminalRole defines the instance specific properties and relationships of a ring terminal.

name: SealState
documentation: Enumeration for the definition of the sealing state of the splice.

name: SlotReference
documentation: A SlotReference represents the usage of a Slot in the context of PartUsage or PartOccurrence.

attributes.name: tpaState
attributes.doc: The state of the terminal position assurance (TPA, syn. secondary locking), if applicable. This is the state of the slot in the integration level described by the model to which the SlotReference belo

name: SpliceTerminalRole
documentation: A SpliceTerminalRole defines the instance specific properties and relationships of a splice terminal.

attributes.name: spliceType
attributes.doc: Specifies the type of splice (inline, end).

attributes.name: insulationState
attributes.doc: Specifies the insulation state of the splice, in other words is electrically insulated or not.

name: SpliceType
documentation: Enumeration for the definition of type of splice.

name: TerminalRole
documentation: A TerminalRole defines the instance specific properties and relationships of a terminal.

attributes.name: sealState
attributes.doc: Specifies if this instance of a terminal should be sealed (waterproof). This applies for example to SpliceTerminals.

name: WireElementReference
documentation: A WireElementReference represents the usage of a WireElement in the context of a PartUsage or PartOccurrence. For contacting purposes, a WireElementReference has WireEnds. KBLFRM-384

attributes.name: identification
attributes.doc: Specifies a unique identification of the WireElementReference. The identification is guaranteed to be unique within the WireRole.

attributes.name: unconnected
attributes.doc: If this attribute is true , the WireElementReference is not connected (unused) on purpose. This can be the case for example if a multi core is used, but not all cores are necessary in a specific situa

attributes.name: labelValue
attributes.doc: Specifies the value of label, if this WireElementReference is labled.

attributes.name: labelPosition
attributes.doc: Specifies the position of label, if this WireElementReference is labled.

attributes.name: labelingTechnology
attributes.doc: Specifies the used LabelingTechnology , if this WireElementReference is labled.

name: WireEnd
documentation: A WireEnd is the end of a wire. This class mainly needed for the definition of a contacting. As a wire can be contacted on more than two ends (e.g. IDC) the WireEnd has a position on the wire.

attributes.name: identification
attributes.doc: Specifies a unique identification of the WireEnd. The identification is guaranteed to be unique within the WireElementReference.

attributes.name: positionOnWire
attributes.doc: Specifies the order of the WireEnds on the WireElementReference . This must be a value between 0 and 1. The PositionOnWire is defined as a floating-point number, to allow the ordering of an arbitrary

attributes.name: cutBackLength
