attributes.doc: Defines the length, by which this WireEnd is cut back relative to the cut length of the outer most WireElementReference (see strippingLength for an example).

attributes.name: strippingLength
attributes.doc: Defines the length by which an insulation on this stripped relative to this WireEnd, defined by the cutBackLength . E.g. a cutBackLength of 20mm and a strippingLength of 10mm means, that this WireElem

attributes.name: insulationPullbackLength
attributes.doc: Defines a partial stripping process in which the insulation is pulled back by the insulationPullbackLength after being cut at the strippingLength and is left on the WireEnd e.g. for logistic reasons.

name: WireGrouping
documentation: A WireGrouping is the definition of a multi core wire in its usage. The elements of a WireGrouping are well defined wires (e.g. with a part number). The grouping itself is only created in its concrete usage. The most common use case is the individual definition of unshielded twisted pair wires without creating the full combinatorics of every possible core / insulation / twist combination in a part master data system (and by this creating part numbers for all of them). However, there are other us

attributes.name: identification
attributes.doc: Specifies a unique identification of the WireGrouping. The identification is guaranteed to be unique within the WireGroupingSpecification.

name: WireGroupingSpecification
documentation: Specification for the description of WireGroupings.

name: WireLength
documentation: Defines the length of a WireElementReference. A WireElementReference can have multiple lengths of different types but must not have more than one length of the same type.

attributes.name: lengthType
attributes.doc: The type of the length. Possible values are defined in an open enumeration (see WireLengthType).

attributes.name: lengthValue
attributes.doc: The length value for the type.

name: WireRole
documentation: A WireRole defines the instance specific properties and relationships of a wire.

name: WireReceptionReference
documentation: A WireReceptionReference is an instance of a WireReception .

attributes.name: identification
attributes.doc: Specifies a unique identification of the WireReceptionReference . The identification is guaranteed to be unique within the TerminalRole (this might be for example a reception number).

name: TerminalReceptionReference
documentation: A TerminalReceptionReference is an instance of a TerminalReception .

attributes.name: identification
attributes.doc: Specifies a unique identification of the TerminalReceptionReference . The identification is guaranteed to be unique within the TerminalRole (this might be for example a reception number).

name: ExtensionSlotReference
documentation: An ExtensionSlotReference represents the usage of an ExtensionSlot in the context of a PartUsage or PartOccurrence.

name: ConnectorHousingCapRole
documentation: A ConnectorHousingCapRole defines the instance-specific properties of a cap for a connector (backshells).

name: WireEndAccessoryRole
documentation: A WireEndAccessoryRole defines the instance specific properties and relationships of a WireEndAccessory .

name: CavityAccessoryRole
documentation: A CavityAccessoryRole defines the instance specific properties and relationships of a cavity accessory.

name: BoltTerminalRole
documentation: A BoltTerminalRole defines the instance specific properties and relationships of a bolt terminal.

name: WireLengthType
documentation: Specifies possible values for the lengthType of WireLength .

name: OpenWireEndTerminalRole
documentation: An OpenWireEndTerminalRole defines the instance specific properties and relationships of an open wire end.

name: BridgeTerminalRole
documentation: A BridgeTerminalRole defines the instance specific properties and relationships of a bridge terminal (see BridgeTerminalSpecification). A bridge terminal is a part that behaves like terminal but has no WireReceptions. It is used to create short circuit between different pins in a connector. In its use, it can realize a schematic connection on its own and independently of other components.

name: WireTupleTermination
documentation: A WireTupleTermination is to define the handling of wire ends in a tuple (group). This is mostly relevant for twisted pairs / triple / tuple to define the handling of untwisting.

attributes.name: fixation
attributes.doc: Defines whether a fixation to prevent untwisting must be applied to associatedWireEnds of this WireTupleTermination .

attributes.name: fixationOffset
attributes.doc: Specifies the offset of the fixation.

attributes.name: permittedUntwist
attributes.doc: Specifies the allowed length of untwist for the WireElementReferences on the sides of associated WireEnds.

name: WireTupleTerminationSpecification
documentation: A WireTupleTerminationSpecification is the container specification for WireTupleTerminations .

name: LabelPosition
documentation: Open Enumeration of standard label positions on WireElementReferences.

name: LabelingRole
documentation: If a component is labeled in its concrete usage, label information is defined with the LabelingRole.

attributes.name: labelType
attributes.doc: Specifies the type of a label printed, stamped or integrated on or in component (e.g. alpha numerical, bar code).

attributes.name: labelValue
attributes.doc: Specifies the value of a label printed on the component.

attributes.name: labelingTechnology
attributes.doc: Specifies the used labeling technology.

name: MultiCavityPlugRole
documentation: A MultiCavityPlugRole defines the instance specific properties and relationships of a multi cavity plug.

name: MultiCavitySealRole
documentation: A MultiCavitySealRole defines the instance specific properties and relationships of a multi cavity seal.

name: AntennaRole
documentation: An AntennaRole defines the instance specific properties and relationships of an antenna.

name: BatteryRole
documentation: An BatteryRole defines the instance specific properties and relationships of a battery.

name: CapacitorRole
documentation: An CapacitorRole defines the instance specific properties and relationships of a capacitor.

name: DiodeRole
documentation: An DiodeRole defines the instance specific properties and relationships of a diode.

name: FuseRole
documentation: An FuseRole defines the instance specific properties and relationships of a fuse.

name: PotentialDistributorRole
documentation: An PotentialDistributorRole defines the instance specific properties and relationships of a potential distributor.

name: RelayRole
documentation: An RelayRole defines the instance specific properties and relationships of a relay.

name: HoleTerminalRole
documentation: An HoleTerminalRole defines the instance specific properties and relationships of a hole terminal.

name: ConnectorLockingState
documentation: Defines the valid states for the connector locking.

name: ConnectorPositionAssuranceState
documentation: Defines the valid states for the connector position assurance (CPA).

name: TerminalPositionAssuranceState
documentation: Defines the valid states for the terminal position assurance (TPA, syn. secondary locking).

name: ConnectorHousingCoverRole
documentation: A ConnectorHousingCoverRole defines the instance-specific properties of a cover for a connector. The association to the ConnectorHousing is established with the OccurrenceOrUsage.ReferenceElement association.

attributes.name: transportOnly
attributes.doc: Specifies if the cover is only used during transportation of the harness. Conversely, transportOnly=false means that the cover might remain in the vehicle, depending on the specific circumstances (e.g

name: CoatingRole
documentation: A CoatingRole defines the instance specific properties of a coating for a WireEnd.

attributes.name: length
attributes.doc: The length over which the coating is applied at the WireEnd , measured from the wire tip.

attributes.name: weight
attributes.doc: The weight of material that shall be used for the coating of WireEnd.

attributes.name: volume
attributes.doc: The volume of material that shall be used for the coating of WireEnd.

name: TerminalProtectionRole
documentation: A TerminalProtectionRole defines the instance specific properties and relationships of a TerminalProtection .

name: SealingPinReference
documentation: A SealingPinReference is an instance of a CableSealEntry.

attributes.name: identification
attributes.doc: Provides an identifier for the SealingPinReference . The Identification shall be unique within a CableSealPlugRole.

name: CableSealPlugRole
documentation: A CableSealPlugRole defines the instance specific properties and relationships of a cable seal plug.

name: CableSealRole
documentation: A CableSealRole defines the instance specific properties and relationships of a cable seal.

name: CableSealEntryReference
documentation: Provides an identifier for the CableSealEntryReference . The Identification shall be unique within a CableSealRole.

attributes.name: positionOnWire
attributes.doc: Specifies the position of this CableSealEntryReference on its associated WireElementReference . This value is analogous to WireEnd.PositionOnWire (see that documentation for details) and must be betwe

attributes.name: sealInsertionDepth
attributes.doc: Defines how far the cable seal is pushed onto the wire, measured from the tip of the corresponding WireEnd .

name: FixingRole
documentation: A FixingRole defines the instance specific properties and relationships of a fixing.

name: GrommetRole
documentation: A GrommetRole defines the instance specific properties and relationships of a grommet.

name: TapingDirection
documentation: Defines the direction in relation to the start & end-Location of the corresponding placement. If no TapingDirection is defined it is arbitrary.

name: WireProtectionRole
documentation: A WireProtectionRole defines the instance specific properties and relationships of a wire protection. This is a general-purpose role for instances of all types of WireProtectionSpecifications that do not have specific instance attributes. For TapeSpecifications the more specific TapeRole shall be used.

attributes.name: protectionLength
attributes.doc: The ProtectionLength specifies the length of the area covered by the protection. As a consequence, the ProtectionLength may differ from the real length of the material (e.g. for tapes).

name: CableDuctRole
documentation: A CableDuctRole defines the instance specific properties and relationships of a cable duct.

name: CableTieRole
documentation: A CableTieRole defines the instance specific properties and relationships of a cable tie.

name: WindingFirmness
documentation: Defines the firmness with which a tape is applied to a segment.

name: WindingType
documentation: Defines the type of taping.

name: TapeRole
documentation: Specific WireProtectionRole for instances of TapeSpecification. This Role is used for all kinds of taping and the WindingType defines the actual type of execution. Not all attributes in the TapeRole are relevant for all WingingTypes . Generating processes and systems are responsible to fill only attributes relevant for the selected WindingType .

attributes.name: tapeOverlap
attributes.doc: Specifies the amount of overlap two rounds of taping around a segment have, as an absolute value. A negative value means, that there is a gap between two rounds.

attributes.name: tapeOverlapRelative
attributes.doc: Specifies the amount of overlap two rounds of taping around a segment have, as a relative value. A negative value means, that there is a gap between two rounds. Values are defined as a factor, not as

attributes.name: tapingDirection
attributes.doc: Specifies the direction of the taping.

attributes.name: gradient
attributes.doc: Specifies the gradient of the taping.

attributes.name: windingType
attributes.doc: Defines the type of the tape's winding (see WindingType ).

attributes.name: windingFirmness
attributes.doc: Defines the firmness of the tape's winding (see WindingFirmness).

attributes.name: numberOfTurns
attributes.doc: Specifies the number of turns, the tape is wrapped around a segment. This is mainly a relevant definition for Spot and Cross tapes.

name: CableLeadThroughReference
documentation: A CableLeadThroughReference is the instance of a CableLeadThrough .

attributes.name: identification
attributes.doc: Specifies a unique identification of the CableLeadThroughReference. The identification is guaranteed to be unique within the GrommetRole.

name: FerriteRole
documentation: A FerriteRole defines the instance specific properties and relationships of a ferrite.

attributes.name: numberOfWindings
attributes.doc: Defines the of windings that the wires are wound around the ferrite.

name: TubeRole
documentation: Specific WireProtectionRole for instances of TubeSpecification.

attributes.name: slitStyle
attributes.doc: Specifies the style of the slitting of the tube. If a slitStyle is defined, it implies that isSlit=true . This attribute is defined as an OpenEnumeration.

attributes.name: isSlit
attributes.doc: Specifies whether the tube is slit or not. The style of the slitting can be defined with the slitStyle. If a slitStyle is defined, it implies that isSlit=true .

name: HoleMountedFixingRole
documentation: An HoleMountedFixingRole defines the instance specific properties and relationships of a hole mounted fixing.

name: EdgeMountedFixingRole
documentation: An EdgeMountedFixingRole defines the instance specific properties and relationships of an edge mounted fixing.

name: BoltMountedFixingRole
documentation: An BoltMountedFixingRole defines the instance specific properties and relationships of a bolt mounted fixing.

name: ShrinkableTubeRole
documentation: Specific WireProtectionRole for instances of ShrinkableTubeSpecification.

name: CorrugatedPipeRole
documentation: Specific WireProtectionRole for instances of CorrugatedPipeSpecification.

attributes.name: cutOnWave
attributes.doc: Defines if the corrugated pipe is cut on top of the corrugation. This applies only to corrugated pipes specified as bulk material. For parts with a predefined length the cutting is defined in the Corr

name: StripeRole
documentation: Specific WireProtectionRole for instances of StripeSpecification.

name: FittingRole
documentation: Specific WireProtectionRole for instances of FittingSpecification.

name: CableLeadThroughOutletReference
documentation: A CableLeadThroughOutletReference is the instance of a CableLeadThroughOutlet . It can define a set of cable seals or plugs as supplementary parts. Plugs are used if no wire is present, seals are used together with a wire.

attributes.name: identification
attributes.doc: Specifies a unique identification of the CableLeadThroughReference. The identification is guaranteed to be unique within the GrommetRole.

name: DocumentBasedInstruction
documentation: A DocumentBasedInstruction is an Instruction to a SheetOrChapter in a DocumentVersion or to a complete DocumentVersion.

name: FileBasedInstruction
documentation: A FileBasedInstruction is an Instruction that references a file packaged (VEC-Package) together with a VEC-file. Such a file can be for example an image.

attributes.name: fileName
attributes.doc: The name of the file as it appears in the VEC-Package, including the folder structure (fully qualified name) that contains this FileBasedInstruction . The usage of this attribute is only valid, if the

attributes.name: lastModified
attributes.doc: The last modified timestamp of the file.

attributes.name: dataFormat
attributes.doc: The dataFormat specifies the format of the FileReference. The dataFormat has to be a valid "Internet Media Type" (see https://www.iana.org/assignments/media-types/media-types.xhtml ).

name: Instruction
documentation: Abstract super class to specify different types of instructions. Possible instructions are text, file or document based.

name: TextBasedInstruction
documentation: A TextBasedInstruction is used to specify human readable instructions in text.

attributes.name: installationInstruction
attributes.doc: Specifies the instruction in a human readable form. Different languages are possible.

name: CavityMapping
documentation: Defines the mapping of two cavities contained Slot A & B of the containing SlotMapping-object.

attributes.name: identificationA
attributes.doc: The identification of the Cavity on side A

attributes.name: identificationB
attributes.doc: The identification of the Cavity on side B

name: Mapping
documentation: The Mapping defines the concrete mapping two parts aliased as A & B. For performance reasons the roles PartSideA and PartSideB are abbreviated to A & B.

attributes.name: identificationA
attributes.doc: Identification of the ConnectorHousingSpecification on side A.

attributes.name: identificationB
attributes.doc: Identification of the ConnectorHousingSpecification on side A.

name: MappingSpecification
documentation: Specification for the description of a CavityMappings . A CavityMapping allows the mapping between the Cavities of two independent ConnectorHousingSpecifications . This is for example needed to determine the mating for an inliner or for the mating between an EE-Component and a ConnectorHousing. The CavityMapping is a part master data.

name: SlotMapping
documentation: Defines the mapping of two slots contained PartVersion A & B of the containing Mapping-object.

attributes.name: identificationA
attributes.doc: The identification of the Slot on side A

attributes.name: identificationB
attributes.doc: The identification of the Slot on side B

attributes.name: layoutIdentificationA
attributes.doc: The identification of a ModularSlotLayout, if the Slot on side A refers to a ModularSlot.

attributes.name: layoutIdentificationB
attributes.doc: The identification of a ModularSlotLayout, if the Slot on side B refers to a ModularSlot.

name: MatingDetail
documentation: If the mating of the two terminals is not unambiguously, a MatingDetail can specify the TerminalReceptions that are mated.

name: MatingPoint
documentation: A MatingPoint defines the Mating of two terminals. This normally occurs when two inliners are connected. Then terminals of one side (female) are mated with terminals of the other side (male).

attributes.name: identification
attributes.doc: Specifies a unique identification of the MatingPoint . The identification is guaranteed to be unique within a CouplingPoint .

name: CouplingSpecification
documentation: Specification for the description of a Coupling. A coupling allows the mapping between independent harness sections or EEComponents of the electrical system. This is done by the mapping of either-or both, ConnectorHousingRoles & TerminalRoles of one side to the other.

name: CouplingPoint
documentation: A CouplingPoint defines a single coupling. If a coupling takes place, all sub elements are connected. If the coupling is disconnected, all sub elements are disconnected. If a coupling occurs between two connectors, and not just between two terminals, the CouplingPoint references the respective ConnectorHousingRoles .

name: SlotCoupling
documentation: A SlotCoupling defines the mapping between two slots of the ConnectorHousingRoles associated with the CouplingPoint .

name: CavityCoupling
documentation: A CavityCoupling defines the mapping between two cavities of the ConnectorHousingRoles associated with the CouplingPoint .

name: ModuleFamily
documentation: A ModuleFamily is a mechanism to group mutually exclusive modules. This could be for example something like "audio equipment", "diesel engine". In other words, a module family groups different variants of the same basic feature. In a real car configuration only one member of the family can participate. For the example module family "audio equipment" the members may be named: "Basic Audio Equipment", "Standard Audio Equipment", "Premium / High End Audio Equipment".

attributes.name: identification
attributes.doc: Specifies a unique identification of the ModuleFamily. The identification is guaranteed to be unique within the ModuleFamilySpecification. For all VEC-documents a ModuleFamily-instance can be trusted

attributes.name: description
attributes.doc: Room for additional, human readable information about the ModuleFamily.

attributes.name: mandatory
attributes.doc: If ' mandatory=true ' applies, then exactly one PartWithSubComponentsRole from the ModuleFamily the must be contained in a valid vehicle configuration, provided that the ModuleFamily itself is valid f

name: ModuleFamilySpecification
documentation: Specification for the description of module families (see ModuleFamily).

name: ModuleList
documentation: A ModuleList is a mechanism to control additional / completion PartOccurrences. This means for a car configuration, if at least one of the modules in the list participates in the configuration, the "completionComponent" participates, too.

attributes.name: identification
attributes.doc: Specifies a unique identification of the ModuleList. The identification is guaranteed to be unique within the ModuleListSpecification. For all VEC-documents a ModuleList-instance can be trusted to be

attributes.name: description
attributes.doc: Room for additional, human readable information about the ModuleList.

name: ModuleListSpecification
documentation: Specification for the description of module lists (see ModuleList).

name: Net
documentation: A Net is an undirected link between NetworkPorts . It defines that the NetworkPorts are related to each other with the Net . A Net is normally an instance of a NetType. E.g. if "CAN-BUS" is defined as a NetType typical Nets would be "BODY-CAN", "AUDIO-CAN".

attributes.name: identification
attributes.doc: Specifies a unique identification of the Net. The identification is guaranteed to be unique within the NetSpecification.

attributes.name: description
attributes.doc: Room for additional, human readable information about the Net.

name: NetGroup
documentation: Defines a logical grouping of specific Nets . For example, it can be used to identify all Nets of specific CAN domain, a function, a requirement level (e.g. Safety & Security).

attributes.name: identification
attributes.doc: Specifies a unique identification of the NetGroup. The identification is guaranteed to be unique within the NetSpecification.

attributes.name: netGroupType
attributes.doc: Specifies the type of the group.

attributes.name: description
attributes.doc: Room for additional, human readable information about the NetGroup.

name: NetSpecification
documentation: Specification for the description of electrological nets.

name: NetworkNode
documentation: A NetworkNode is a representative for an actor in the electric system, e.g. an actuator, a sensor, an ECU.

attributes.name: identification
attributes.doc: Specifies a unique identification of the NetworkNode. The identification is guaranteed to be unique within the NetSpecification.

attributes.name: abbreviation
attributes.doc: Room for a short name of the NetworkNode.

attributes.name: networkNodeType
attributes.doc: Specifies the type of a NetworkNode. Common values are agreed as an OpenEnumeration .

attributes.name: description
attributes.doc: Room for additional, human readable information about the NetworkNode.

attributes.name: subType
attributes.doc: Specifies the sub type of a NetworkNode. The sub type allows a differentiation within a specific type. E.g. an actuator can be differentiated into lamps, speakers, motors.

name: NetworkPort
documentation: NetworkPort is the source or the receiver of a of a Net.

attributes.name: identification
attributes.doc: Specifies a unique identification of the NetworkPort. The identification is guaranteed to be unique within the NetSpecification.

attributes.name: aliasId
attributes.doc: Specifies additional identifiers for the element.

attributes.name: signalDirection
attributes.doc: Specifies the direction of the signal on this NetworkPort.

attributes.name: description
attributes.doc: Room for additional, human readable information about the NetworkPort.

name: SignalDirection
documentation: Enumeration for the definition of SignalDirections.

name: NetworkNodeType
documentation: Defines the common agreed values for the Types of a NetworkNode.

name: NetType
documentation: A NetType defines the different types of Nets used in the NetSpecification . The level of detail of the NetTypes for the can be process dependent. A NetType could be just used to differentiate between conventional (analogue) communication and bus communication (digital), it can also already define the different types of digital communication (e.g. CAN, MOST, Ethernet).

attributes.name: identification
attributes.doc: Specifies a unique identification of the NetType. The identification is guaranteed to be unique within the NetSpecification.

attributes.name: description
attributes.doc: Room for additional, human readable information about the NetType .

attributes.name: signalTransmissionMediumType
attributes.doc: Specifies the type of the transmission medium for signals of this type.

name: NetworkNodeSubType
documentation: Defines agreed values for NetworkNodeSubTypes . Not all combinations of NetworkNodeSubTypes and NetworkNodeTypes are semantically correct (e.g. Lamp, Microphone, Speaker, Motor are all Actuators).

name: NetViewSpecification
documentation: The NetViewSpecification supports the exchange of a basic layout for a NetSpecification .

name: NetworkNodeViewItem
documentation: A NetworkNodeViewItem represents a NetworkNode within a NetViewSpecification and defines its position within the layout.

attributes.name: identification
attributes.doc: Specifies a unique identification of the NetworkNodeViewItem . The identification is guaranteed to be unique within the NetViewSpecification .

attributes.name: gridSquare
attributes.doc: Specifies the grid square in which the NodeViewItem is placed (e.g. E/40).

name: NetworkPortViewItem
documentation: A NetworkPortViewItem represents a NetworkPort within a NetworkNodeViewItem and defines its position on the node.

attributes.name: side
attributes.doc: Specifies the side of the NetworkNodeViewItem on which the port should be displayed.

name: BoltMountedFixingSpecification
documentation: Specification for fixings that are mounted onto a bolt. This means the fixing itself has got a hole, which is mounted onto a bolt of the surrounding.

attributes.name: boltType
attributes.doc: Specifies the type of the bolt on which the fixing can be mounted.

attributes.name: boltShape
attributes.doc: Specifies the shape of the bolt on which the fixing can be mounted.

attributes.name: boltDiameter
attributes.doc: Specifies the diameter of the bolt on which the fixing can be mounted.

attributes.name: boltHeight
attributes.doc: Specifies the height of the bolt on which the fixing can be mounted.

name: CableDuctOutlet
documentation: Specifies one outlet of the cable duct.

attributes.name: identification
attributes.doc: Specifies the identification of the Outlet. This must be unique within a CableDuctSpecification.

name: CableDuctSpecification
documentation: Specification for cable ducts. A cable duct can have one or more outlets.

name: CableLeadThrough
documentation: A CableLeadThrough specifies a hole in the grommet through which wires can pass through the grommet. There can be different technical realizations of a lead through, e.g. it can be realized with a shrinking material or an additional seal. The properties of a CableLeadThrough are defined in the referenced CableLeadThroughSpecification . For a precise placement in topology, a CableLeadThrough specifies outlets.

attributes.name: identification
attributes.doc: Specifies the identification of the CableLeadThrough. This must be unique within a GrommetSpecification.

name: CorrugatedPipeSpecification
documentation: Specification for the definition of corrugated pipes.

attributes.name: corrugationHeight
attributes.doc: Specifies the height of a corrugation of the pipe.

attributes.name: corrugationWidth
attributes.doc: Specifies the width of a corrugation of the pipe.

attributes.name: corrugationGradient
attributes.doc: Specifies the gradient of a corrugation of the pipe.

attributes.name: cutOnWave
attributes.doc: Defines if the corrugated pipe is cut on top of the corrugation. This applies only to corrugated pipes that have a defined length. For bulk material in the cutting is defined in the CorrugatedPipeRole

name: EdgeMountedFixingSpecification
documentation: Specification for fixings that are mounted onto an edge.

attributes.name: edgeThickness
attributes.doc: Defines a range of valid thicknesses, onto which the fixing can be mounted.

name: FittingOutlet
documentation: Specifies one outlet of the fitting.

attributes.name: identification
attributes.doc: Specifies the identification of the Outlet. This must be unique within a FittingSpecification.

attributes.name: innerDiameter
attributes.doc: Specifies the inner diameter of the outlet.

attributes.name: outerDiameter
attributes.doc: Specifies the outer diameter of the outlet.

attributes.name: nominalSize
attributes.doc: Defines the nominal size of a tube. The nominal size is a name for the size of the tube that is somehow related to the inner diameter of the tube. However, it is not the inner diameter (e.g. "10.5").

name: FittingSpecification
documentation: Specification for the definition of fittings. A fitting is a part that is used to connect pipes or tube. A fitting has a specific form (e.g. Y,T)

attributes.name: form
attributes.doc: Specifies the form of the fitting (e.g. Y, T).

name: FixingSpecification
documentation: Specification for the definition of fixings. A fixing is used to fix the harness in a certain position (e.g. at the car body, a seat, an ECU etc.). The FixingSpecification describes how the fixing is attached to the "non-harness" element. The attachment to harness is described by a PlaceableElementSpecification.

attributes.name: offset
attributes.doc: Offset between the origin of a fixing (which is defined by its installed position on the car body), and the placement point on the harness. See Diagram "Fixing Coordinates and Dimensions" for details.

attributes.name: maximumWidthA
attributes.doc: The maximum width of the fixing, measured from the placement plane (XZ-plane) in the direction of the Y-axis (direction of the harness, passing through the fixing). See Diagram "Fixing Coordinates and

attributes.name: maximumWidthB
attributes.doc: The maximum width of the fixing, measured from the placement plane (XZ-plane) in the opposite direction of the Y-axis (direction of the harness, passing through the fixing). See Diagram "Fixing Coordi

name: GrommetSpecification
documentation: Specification for the definition of grommets.

attributes.name: hardness
attributes.doc: Specifies the hardness of the grommet.

attributes.name: holeDiameter
attributes.doc: Specifies the valid diameter of a hole into which the grommet fits.

attributes.name: plateThickness
attributes.doc: Specifies valid the plate thickness at the hole into which the grommet fits.

attributes.name: grommetType
attributes.doc: Specifies the type of the grommet.

attributes.name: mountingType
attributes.doc: Defines how the grommet is mounted onto the harness (not the vehicle body).

name: HoleMountedFixingSpecification
documentation: Specification for fixings that are mounted into a hole. This means the fixing has got a bolt which is mounted into a hole of the surrounding.

attributes.name: holeDiameter
attributes.doc: Specifies the diameter of the hole in which the fixing is mounted.

attributes.name: plateThickness
attributes.doc: Specifies the thickness of the plate in which the hole is positioned.

attributes.name: holeType
attributes.doc: Specifies the type of how the fixing is fixated in the hole. In other words, it defines what features the hole has to provide to allow a fixation of the fixing.

attributes.name: holeShape
attributes.doc: Specifies the shape of the hole in horizontal direction (the plain on which the fixing is fixated).

name: ShrinkableTubeSpecification
documentation: Specification of tubes that are shrinkable.

attributes.name: shrinkingFactor
attributes.doc: Defines the factor of shrinking for the tube.

attributes.name: maximumLongitudinalShrinkage
attributes.doc: Defines the shrinkage in longitudinal direction.

attributes.name: resin
attributes.doc: Defines the material of the resin usable for this shrinkable tube.

attributes.name: waterAbsorbtion
attributes.doc: Defines the water absorption of the shrinkable tube specification.

name: StripeSpecification
documentation: Specifies a stripe which has fixed length and width. A stripe is a textile, foam or similar piece with fixed length & width that is wrapped around the harness.

attributes.name: length
attributes.doc: Specifies the length of the stripe.

attributes.name: segmentDiameter
attributes.doc: Specifies the valid segment diameter range for which the stripe can be used.

attributes.name: width
attributes.doc: Specifies the width of the stripe.

attributes.name: thickness
attributes.doc: Specifies the thickness of the stripe (adhesive + backing).

name: TapeSpecification
documentation: Specification for the description of tapes.

attributes.name: backing
attributes.doc: Specifies the material of carrier of the tape, on which the adhesive material is applied.

attributes.name: adhesive
attributes.doc: Specifies the adhesive material of the tape.

attributes.name: width
attributes.doc: Specifies the width of the tape.

attributes.name: thickness
attributes.doc: Specifies the thickness of the tape (adhesive + backing).

attributes.name: coilCoreDiameter
attributes.doc: Specifies the inner diameter of the coil on which the tape is delivered.

name: TubeSpecification
documentation: Specifies tubes.

attributes.name: bendRadius
attributes.doc: Specifies the bend radius of the tube.

attributes.name: innerDiameter
attributes.doc: Defines the inner diameter of a tube. In the case of a shrinkable tube, it is the diameter of the tube in the unshrinked state.

attributes.name: wallThickness
attributes.doc: Specifies the thickness of the wall of the tube.

attributes.name: isSlit
attributes.doc: Specifies whether the tube is slit or not. The style of the slitting can be defined with the slitStyle. If a slitStyle is defined, it implies that isSlit=true .

attributes.name: slitStyle
attributes.doc: Specifies the style of the slitting of the tube. If a slitStyle is defined, it implies that isSlit=true . This attribute is defined as an OpenEnumeration.

attributes.name: nominalSize
attributes.doc: Defines the nominal size of a tube. The nominal size is a name for the size of the tube that is somehow related to the inner diameter of the tube. However, it is not the inner diameter (e.g. "10.5").

attributes.name: secondaryNominalSize
attributes.doc: Defines the secondary nominal size of a tube. The nominal size is a name for the size of the tube that is somehow related to the inner diameter of the tube. However, it is not the inner diameter (e.g.

attributes.name: shape
attributes.doc: Specifies the shape of the cross section of the tube. This attribute is defined as an OpenEnumeration

attributes.name: outerDiameter
attributes.doc: Specifies the outer diameter of the tube. The outer diameter of a tube shall only be used for circular tubes (shape = Circular). For other shapes, height and width shall be used.

attributes.name: height
attributes.doc: Specifies the height of the tube. If the height is defined, a width shall be defined, too. The height and width of a tube shall only be used for tubes that are not circular (shape != Circular). For ci

attributes.name: width
attributes.doc: Specifies the width of the tube. If the width is defined, a height shall be defined, too. The height and width of a tube shall only be used for tubes that are not circular (shape != Circular). For cir

attributes.name: length
attributes.doc: Specifies the length of the tube if it is a predefined value.

name: WireProtectionSpecification
documentation: Specification for the description of wire protections.

attributes.name: soundDampingClass
attributes.doc: Specifies the class of sound damping. According to the VDA this is a value between A & E. KBLFRM-311

name: CableTieSpecification
documentation: Specification for the definition of cable ties.

name: TubeShape
documentation: Defines valid shapes of the cross section of a tube.

name: TubeSlitStyle
documentation: Defines valid types / styles of a slitted tube.

name: CableLeadThroughSpecification
documentation: A CableLeadThrough specifies a hole in the grommet through which wires can pass through the grommet. The CableLeadThroughSpecification defines the technical properties of a CableLeadThrough (or a set of similar ones).

attributes.name: type
attributes.doc: Defines the type of a cable lead through. Standardized values are defined in an OpenEnumeration .

attributes.name: geometry
attributes.doc: Defines the geometry of a cable lead through in the sealing area. Standardized values are defined in an OpenEnumeration .

attributes.name: sealingDimension
attributes.doc: Specifies the dimension of the cable lead through in the sealing area.

attributes.name: minSegmentOutsideDiameter
attributes.doc: Specifies the minimum diameter a segment can have to fit through the cable lead through. This definition is necessary, since segments that are too small might cause movements and unacceptable torsion

attributes.name: maxSegmentOutsideDiameter
attributes.doc: Specifies the maximum diameter a segment can have to fit into the cable lead through.

attributes.name: sealable
attributes.doc: Specifies if the cable lead through is sealable.

name: CableLeadThroughType
documentation: Defines valid types for CableLeadThroughs.

name: CableLeadThroughGeometry
documentation: Defines valid values for the geometry of a CableLeadThrough in the sealing area.

name: FerriteSpecification
documentation: Specification for the definition of ferrites.

name: FittingForm
documentation: OpenEnumeration to define different fitting forms.

name: BoltMountedFixingBoltType
documentation: OpenEnumeration for the types of the bolts on which the fixing can be mounted.

name: BoltMountedFixingBoltShape
documentation: OpenEnumeration for the shapes of the bolts on which the fixing can be mounted.

name: CableLeadThroughOutlet
documentation: Specifies one outlet of a CableLeadThrough . For most CableLeadThroughs , there will be two.

attributes.name: identification
attributes.doc: Specifies the identification of the CableLe adThroughOutlet. This must be unique within a CableLeadThrough .

name: ProtectionMaterialLength
documentation: Defines the material length of a WireProtectionRole . A WireProtectionRole can have multiple lengths of different types but must not have more than one length of the same type.

name: HoleMountedFixingHoleType
documentation: Open Enumeration of standard hole types (see HoleMountedFixingSpecification.holeType).

name: HoleMountedFixingHoleShape
documentation: Open Enumeration of standard hole shapes (see HoleMountedFixingSpecification.holeShape).

name: WireProtectionGroupSpecification
documentation: Specification for the description of WireProtectionGroups .

name: WireProtectionGroup
documentation: A WireProtectionGroup is the definition of a set of WireProtectionRoles to which the following rules apply: The WireProtectionGroup defines a processing instruction, not a precise product specification. All transitions between adjacent elements in group shall be implemented continuous, without interruption, wherever technically possible. The elements of a WireProtectionGroup can be subject to variance depending on the scenario in a specific 100% configuration. Meaning, some elements of the group

attributes.name: identification
attributes.doc: Specifies a unique identification of the WireProtectionGroup . The identification is guaranteed to be unique within the WireProtectionGroupSpecification .

name: CompositionSpecification
documentation: The CompositionSpecificiation is used to define a set of occurrences required to describe unambiguously the design of a composite part. This does not have to be necessarily the same occurrences which are building the bill of material. Example: A company might want to regard an antenna cable as one part out of a bill of material perspective. However, at the same time it may be useful for the company to be able to describe the contacting of the antenna cable within the VEC. (see also PartStructure

name: PartOccurrence
documentation: A PartOccurrence is an instance of a component with a specified part number (PartVersion).

attributes.name: isSecondaryAlternative
attributes.doc: If a PartUsage is realized by more than one PartOccurrence it is possible to specify which one is the preferred. (see KBLFRM-264)

name: PartStructureSpecification
documentation: Specification for the description of a part structure. This specification defines the PartOccurrences that are in the bill of material of the described PartOrUsage. This is necessary, because it is possible, that for a definite description a Part more PartOccurrences are needed than the ones that are in the bill of material (see CompositionSpecification).

attributes.name: content
attributes.doc: Specifies the type of content of the bill of material (e.g. module, harness complete set)

attributes.name: definedAsEmpty
attributes.doc: If true the PartStructureSpecification defines a part that has no OccurrenceOrUsage in its inBillOfMaterial on purpose. Such parts are sometimes required to satisfy certain variant management methods.

name: PartStructureContentType
documentation: OpenEnumeration that defines standard content types for the PartStructureSpecification.

name: PartUsage
documentation: PartUsages shall be used for the specification of the elements on an electrical system wiring plan and for the specification of the elements on a pure geometry description. PartUsages shall more than ever be used in cases where it is necessary to describe a certain instance of a part or part group, possibly together with certain technical properties, but where it is at the same time yet not possible to define a concrete part number.

attributes.name: primaryPartUsageType
attributes.doc: The primary type of the PartUsage defines the type of the described part (e.g. ConnectorHousing, Fixing, etc.) Since the VEC supports dual use parts (e.g. Fixing & WireProtection) there is no direct c

name: PartUsageSpecification
documentation: Specification for the definition of PartUsages.

name: Approval
documentation: Defines the approval of an ItemVersion. This consists of the StatusOfApproval, and the Permissions issued for the approval.

attributes.name: identification
attributes.doc: Specifies a unique identification of the approval. The identification is guaranteed to be unique over all VEC-documents. Normally this would reference to a company specific approval number or somethin

attributes.name: description
attributes.doc: Room for additional information about the item.

attributes.name: companyInScope
attributes.doc: Room to specify for which companies the Approval is valid. It might be e.g. that an approved Item may only be delivered by some specific company.

attributes.name: status
attributes.doc: The approval level concerning approval status. Predefined are the values: NotYetApproved, Approved and Withdrawn. The status refers to the status of the Approval , not the status of the ItemVersion. S

attributes.name: levelOfApproval
attributes.doc: Relates to activities that are allowed with the ItemVersion after release for example building pilot tools or production tools. The levelOfApproval applies to the ItemVersion itself without further de

attributes.name: additionalLevelInformation
attributes.doc: Additional potentially company specific information about the level of approval (e.g. further detailing of a "Restricted" approval.

name: ChangeDescription
documentation: A ChangeDescription describes the implemented issues that are reason for the aggregating ItemVersion to be either an initial or successor version. A ChangeDescription can optionally define the person who has approved the change.

attributes.name: identification
attributes.doc: Specifies an identifier for the ChangeDescription. This can be the ID of a change order or an ID which indicates model upgrading. (see KBLFRM-249)

attributes.name: label
attributes.doc: Specifies the label of the change on a drawing for example. If more than one change is issued with one ItemVersion (e.g. change 0001, 0002), in some cases the different changes are labelled on the dra

attributes.name: description
attributes.doc: Specifies additional, human readable, information about the ChangeDescription.

attributes.name: approver
attributes.doc: Specifies the person who has approved the change.

attributes.name: changeDate
attributes.doc: Specifies the date when the change was performed.

attributes.name: responsibleDesigner
attributes.doc: Specifies the design engineer who is/was responsible to perform the change.

attributes.name: relatedChangeRequest
attributes.doc: Specifies the identification of a corresponding change request. (see KBLFRM-249)

name: Contract
documentation: A Contract-instance describes the relationship between an ItemVersion-instance and a Company-instance additionally defining the role the company takes in reference to the ItemVersion.

attributes.name: companyName
attributes.doc: Specifies the company which acts in the specified Role in the Contract Relationship.

attributes.name: contractRole
attributes.doc: The role the company takes in reference to the associated ItemVersion. Predefined are the values: OEM, Supplier and Manufacturer.

name: ContractRole
documentation: Enumeration for the definition of roles a contractor has in a contract.

name: CopyrightInformation
documentation: A CopyrightInformation-instance specifies copyright information for one or more Items.

attributes.name: copyrightNote
attributes.doc: An informal text which specifies copyright information.

name: Creation
documentation: A Creation-instance provides additional information to the owning ItemVersion stating personal information on the creator and the creation date.

attributes.name: creationDate
attributes.doc: Specifies the date when the associated ItemVersion was created. (see KBLFRM-241)

attributes.name: creator
attributes.doc: Specifies the person who has created the Item.

attributes.name: responsibleDesigner
attributes.doc: Specifies the person, which is the responsible designer for the ItemVersion at the point of creation.

name: HistoryEntryType
documentation: Enumeration for the definition of the type of relationship represented by an ItemHistoryEntry. (see KBLFRM-271)

name: ItemEquivalence
documentation: Defines two or more ItemVersions to be equivalent out of the view of a certain company. The ItemEquivalence class will most likely be used by a company to express which PartNumber a certain PartVersion has in the context of other companies (same applies to DocumentVersions ). However, for every other company separate ItemEquivalences are needed as the statement of equivalence can be very subjective.

attributes.name: companyName
attributes.doc: Specifies the company which states the ItemEquivalence.

name: ItemHistoryEntry
documentation: An ItemHistoryEntry defines the direct relationship between ItemVersions in the terms of predecessor and successor. There are two possible types of relationships between ItemVersions, derivation and sequence. Derivation means for example for parts, that the successor version is a new part developed on the base of the predecessor version. Sequence means the successor version is an improvement of the predecessor version. By the combination of more than one ItemHistoryEntry a linear sequence of Ite

attributes.name: type
attributes.doc: Specifies the type of relationship between the ItemVersions.

name: Permission
documentation: Describes an act of acceptance together with information about the responsible person, department and company who directly provoked the approval level and status as described in the referenced Approval-instance. (see KBLFRM-229)

attributes.name: permission
attributes.doc: Specifies the type of permission. Predefined values are: Seen, Checked, Released.

attributes.name: permissionDate
attributes.doc: Specifies the date when the permission was stated.

attributes.name: permitter
attributes.doc: Specifies the person who was involved in the approval process giving a certain Permission.

name: Person
documentation: Specifies all relevant data of a person.

attributes.name: companyName
attributes.doc: Specifies the name of the company the person belongs to.

attributes.name: department
attributes.doc: Specifies the department the person belongs to.

attributes.name: firstName
attributes.doc: Specifies the person's first name.

attributes.name: lastName
attributes.doc: Specifies the person's last name.

attributes.name: phoneNumber
attributes.doc: Specifies the person's phone number.

attributes.name: emailAddress
attributes.doc: Specifies the person's email address.

attributes.name: aliasId
attributes.doc: Specifies identifiers for the Person in different contexts.

name: Project
documentation: Specifies a certain vehicle project. Instances of this class are assumed to be constant. Thus, this is located directly under VEC-root element. A vehicle project can be some abstract or concrete node in the product structure, addressed by the car classification levels.

attributes.name: carClassificationLevel2
attributes.doc: Provides a classification according to "CC8 Recommended Practices Specification and Configuration, Product Structures". Car classification is the identification of a set of similar cars to be offered

attributes.name: carClassificationLevel3
attributes.doc: Provides a classification according to "CC8 Recommended Practices Specification and Configuration, Product Structures". Car classification is the identification of a set of similar cars to be offered

attributes.name: carClassificationLevel4
attributes.doc: Provides a classification according to "CC8 Recommended Practices Specification and Configuration, Product Structures". Car classification is the identification of a set of similar cars to be offered

attributes.name: identification
attributes.doc: Specifies the development order number (car or engine project)

attributes.name: description
attributes.doc: Room for additional information about the item.

name: StatusOfApproval
documentation: Enumeration for the definition of the state of an approval.

name: TypeOfPermission
documentation: Enumeration for the definition of the type of a permission.

name: LevelOfApproval
documentation: The LevelOfApproval standardizes the approval levels most engineering processes have in common. See Approval.levelOfApproval for more details.

name: Color
documentation: Specifies a color value. A color is always defined by a key value. What color is meant by this key value is defined by a standard reference system (e.g. RAL). For example, if a RAL color should be expressed in the terms of the VEC the referenceSystem would be "RAL", the key would be the RAL number defined by the standard (e.g. "1003" for signal yellow). Color-attributes normally have the multiplicity [0..*]. This means that such an attribute can have a value for different referenceSystems (e.g.

attributes.name: key
attributes.doc: The key of the color in the corresponding color reference system.

attributes.name: referenceSystem
attributes.doc: The identification of the color reference system, which is defining possible values and the semantic of color keys. (see KBLFRM-315). For common color reference systems, the literals defined in the op

attributes.name: description
attributes.doc: On optional human readable description of the color (e.g. the name).

name: CompositeUnit
documentation: Defines a unit as a composition of other units. The composition is done by multiplying the different other units. By this way combined units like kg/m can be formed.

name: CustomUnit
documentation: A CustomUnit can be used to define "Free Text"-Units. Custom units must not be used for units that can be expressed by any of the other subclasses of Unit. Custom units are only allowed if a unit is needed that cannot be handled by any of the other classes.

attributes.name: identification
attributes.doc: A unique identification of the custom unit.

name: IECPrefix
documentation: Enumeration for the definition of IEC unit prefixes.

name: IECUnit
documentation: The IECUnit class can define quantities in the terms of the IEC-Unit-System by specifying the corresponding IEC prefix (optional) and an IEC unit name.

attributes.name: iecUnitName
attributes.doc: Specifies the name of the IEC unit.

attributes.name: iecPrefix
attributes.doc: Specifies the prefix of the IEC unit.

name: IECUnitName
documentation: Enumeration for the definition of IEC unit names.

name: ImperialUnit
documentation: The ImperialUnit class can define quantities in the terms of the Imperial-Unit-System by specifying the corresponding Imperial unit name.

attributes.name: imperialUnitName
attributes.doc: Specifies the name of the imperial unit.

name: ImperialUnitName
documentation: Enumeration for the definition of imperial unit names.

name: MassInformation
documentation: Allows the definition of mass information. Attributes of the type MassInformation normally have the multiplicity [0..*]. This means that such an attribute can have mass values for different determinationTypes and valueSources . It must not have multiple values for the same determinationType and valueSource .

attributes.name: determinationType
attributes.doc: Specifies the determination type of the mass information.

attributes.name: value
attributes.doc: Specifies the mass as numerical value.

attributes.name: valueSource
attributes.doc: The valueSource defines in an OpenEnumeration the source from which the MassInformation has been retrieved. This information, in combination with the ValueDetermination gives a hint about the reliabil

name: Material
documentation: Allows the definition of material information. Material- attributes normally have the multiplicity [0..*]. This means that such an attribute can have material values for different referenceSystems . It must not have multiple values for the same referenceSystems .

attributes.name: key
attributes.doc: The key of the material in the corresponding material reference system.

attributes.name: referenceSystem
attributes.doc: The identification of the material reference system, which is defining possible values and the semantic of material keys.

attributes.name: description
attributes.doc: On optional human readable description of the material (e.g. the name).

name: NumericalValue
documentation: A quantity expressed with a numerical value and a unit.

attributes.name: valueComponent
attributes.doc: Specifies the value of the numerical value.

name: OtherUnit
documentation: The OtherUnit class can be used to define a unit, which is necessary in the context of data exchange but not contained in the standard systems (e.g. Piece).

attributes.name: otherUnitName
attributes.doc: Specifies the name of the unit.

name: OtherUnitName
documentation: Enumeration for the definition of other unit names.

name: RobustnessProperties
documentation: Allows the definition of robustness properties. Robustness of a component is specified as a level of robustness against a specific influence (e.g. oil, water, UV-light). The influence is specified by the class and the level is specified by the classKey . Valid robustness classes and keys are specified by the reference system. Attributes of the type RobustnessProperties normally have the multiplicity [0..*]. This means that such an attribute can have RobustnessProperties entries for different cla

attributes.name: class
attributes.doc: Specifies the identifier of a robustness class defined by the robustness class reference system. Robustness classes are for example: oil, petrol, UV, water. Specific known and used classes are defined

attributes.name: classKey
attributes.doc: Specifies a key for the robustness level defined in the specified robustness class (e.g. A, B, C). The classKey is the key as specified in the reference system and no additional syntax or prefixes, e.

attributes.name: classReferenceSystem
attributes.doc: The identification of the robustness class reference system, which is defining possible values and the semantic of robustness classes and robustness class keys. Specific known and used reference syste

attributes.name: hasRobustness
attributes.doc: Specifies if the described element has a robustness in the specified robustness class. (see KBLFRM-260)

attributes.name: description
attributes.doc: On optional human readable description of the robustness (e.g. the name).

name: SIUnit
documentation: The SIUnit class can define quantities in the terms of the SI-Unit-System by specifying the corresponding SI prefix (optional) and a SI unit name. The usage of SI units must be the preferred way of expressing units, since these units can be easily translated into other SI units.

attributes.name: siUnitName
attributes.doc: Specifies the name of SI unit (e.g. metre, second,...)

attributes.name: siPrefix
attributes.doc: Specifies the prefix of the SI unit (e.g. milli, centi, micro,...)

name: SiPrefix
documentation: Enumeration for the definition of SI unit prefixes.

name: SiUnitName
documentation: Enumeration for the definition of SI unit names. In difference to the SI-System gram is used as literal for the measurement of mass, instead of kilogram. Since a unit is formed with prefix and unit name gram would have to be defined as milli kilogram otherwise.

name: Size
documentation: Defines the size of an element by width & height. Per definition is width >= height.

attributes.name: width
attributes.doc: The width of the element.

attributes.name: height
attributes.doc: The height of the element.

name: SoundDampingClass
documentation: Allows the definition of a sound damping class. The sound damping class of a component is specified as a level of sound damping. The level is specified by the classKey . Valid keys are specified by the referenceSystem . Attributes of the type SoundDampingClass normally have the multiplicity [0..*]. This means that such an attribute can have SoundDampingClass entries for different referenceSystems . It must not have multiple entries for the same referenceSystem .

attributes.name: classKey
attributes.doc: Specifies a key for the level defined in the sound damping class (e.g. A, B, C).

attributes.name: referenceSystem
attributes.doc: The identification of the sound damping class reference system, which is defining possible values and the semantic of sound damping keys.

name: TemperatureInformation
documentation: Defines valid temperature ranges for a general technical part. A part can have different valid temperature ranges in different scenarios e.g. operating temperature, storage temperature, processing temperature, environment temperature. A class can own multiple TemperatureInformations but must not have more than one TemperatureInformations of the same temperatureType.

attributes.name: temperatureRange
attributes.doc: Specifies the allowed temperature range for this type of temperature.

attributes.name: temperatureType
attributes.doc: The type of a TemperatureInformation.

name: Tolerance
documentation: A Tolerance defines the permissible limit or limits of variation for defined values (e.g. a NumericalValue ). The tolerated value is defined by the context in which the Tolerance is contained / used. The values of the limits of the Tolerance , LowerBoundary and UpperBoundary , shall be interpreted as "modifiers" to the actual value. To obtain an absolute range of valid values, the values of boundaries shall be added to the actual value, regardless of the Upper or Lower prefix. For example, to de

attributes.name: lowerBoundary
attributes.doc: Specifies the lower boundary for the tolerance.

attributes.name: upperBoundary
attributes.doc: Specifies the upper boundary for the tolerance.

name: Unit
documentation: A precisely specified quantity in terms of which the magnitudes of other quantities of the same kind can be stated. The different systems to define units are represented by the subclasses of this class (e.g. SIUnit, ImperialUnit).

attributes.name: exponent
attributes.doc: Defines the exponent with which this unit instance should be used. In order to define square meters for example, the SIUnit "metre" with an exponent of 2 will be used. If no exponent is defined it is

attributes.name: unEceCode
attributes.doc: The UNECE provides a list of " Codes for Units of Measurement used in the International Trade ". This attribute shall be used for traceability of Units defined in the VEC into the UNECE system only. I

name: ValueDetermination
documentation: Enumeration for the definition of a value determination. (see KBLFRM-316)

name: ValueRange
documentation: A pair of numerical values representing a value range.

attributes.name: minimum
attributes.doc: Lower bound of the value range.

attributes.name: maximum
attributes.doc: Upper bound of the value range.

name: ValueWithUnit
documentation: Abstract class either for a single numerical measure or a range of numerical measures with upper, lower, or upper and lower bounds.

name: USUnit
documentation: The USUnit class can define quantities in the terms of the US-Unit-System by specifying the corresponding US unit name. The US Unit System is quite similar to the imperial unit system; however, some units are defined slightly different.

attributes.name: usUnitName
attributes.doc: Specifies the name of the USUnit .

name: USUnitName
documentation: Enumeration for the definition of US unit names.

name: BoundingBox
documentation: The bounding box is defined for the processed state of the component, as it appears in the finished product. Therefore, it is valid to use the bounding box as simplified geometry of the component for viewing or simple DMU operations. For correct 3D positioning, the bounding might require a transformation in the coordinate system of the component (see LocalGeometrySpecification.BoundingBoxPositioning ). The bounding box defines the smallest cuboid (box) that can contain a described part completel

attributes.name: x
attributes.doc: Defines the extent of the bounding box in the direction of x (length).

attributes.name: y
attributes.doc: Defines the extent of the bounding box in the direction of y (width).

attributes.name: z
attributes.doc: Defines the extent of the bounding box in the direction of z (height).

name: MassInformationSource
documentation: Defines possible sources for MassInformations .

name: RobustnessClass
documentation: Defines the literals that shall be used for specific robustness classes.

name: RobustnessClassReferenceSystem
documentation: Defines the literals that shall be used for specific robustness class reference systems.

name: ColorReferenceSystem
documentation: Defines the literals that shall be used for specific color reference systems.

name: TemperatureType
documentation: Defines the type (scenario) for which a TemperatureInformation applies.

name: MaterialComposition
documentation: Parts and components are often composed from a material-mix. The MaterialComposition allows the definition of the various Material s in a part and their mass.

attributes.name: material
attributes.doc: Specifies the material of this composition entry with the syntax and nomenclature of an arbitrary reference system.

attributes.name: massInformation
attributes.doc: Specifies the mass of this corresponding Material in a part per Unit of quantity (e.g. g/piece or g/meter...) of the part.

name: MultiDimensionalValue
documentation: The MultiDimensionalValue represents a set of values defined across multiple Dimension s. It is used to describe properties that vary along several axes, such as characteristic curves. Each DataPoint assigned to a MultiDimensionalValue must define one DataPointValue per Dimension .

name: QuantityKind
documentation: A QuantityKind is any observable property that can be measured and quantified numerically. Familiar examples include physical properties such as length, mass, time, force, energy, power, electric charge, etc. A quantity (not represented as class in the VEC) would always be associated with the context of measurement (i.e. the thing measured, the measured value, the accuracy of measurement, etc.) whereas the underlying QuantityKind is independent of any particular measurement. A QuantityKind provi

attributes.name: identification
attributes.doc: Specifies a unique identification of the QuantityKind . The identification is guaranteed to be unique within a VEC . Furthermore, the same QuantityKind shall have the same Identification for different

attributes.name: name
attributes.doc: A human readable name of the QuantityKind for example used as axis label in a visual diagram.

name: DataPoint
documentation: A DataPoint represents one set of values in a MultiDimensionalValue . It contains multiple DataPointValue s, one for each QuantityKind referenced as d imension . Each DataPoint thereby defines a complete point in the value space. Each DataPoint shall define a DataPointValue for all d imensions of its MultiDimensionalValue .

name: DataPointValue
documentation: A DataPointValue assigns a concrete numeric value to one d imension within a DataPoint . Each DataPointValue must only reference a QuantityKind that is defined as Dimension of its owning MultiDimensionalValue .

name: MeasurementPoint
documentation: Defines a reference point on a component that can be used to apply a Dimension. This is normally a significant point of the component e.g. an edge, a hole, a bolt or something similar.

attributes.name: identification
attributes.doc: Specifies a unique identification of the MeasurementPoint. The identification is guaranteed to be unique within a component.

name: PlaceableElementSpecification
documentation: Specification for the general aspects of a component that are enabling the component to be placed in a topology. All components that should have the ability to be placed on a certain position in the topology must have a PlaceableElementSpecification.

attributes.name: validPlacementTypes
attributes.doc: Defines the PlacementTypes that are valid for this element.

name: PlacementPoint
documentation: Defines a point on the component which can be placed explicitly in the topology (e.g. opening in a grommet, the entry point of a connector housing). If a PlacementPoint requires further specification for a certain component type (e.g. the entry point of a connector housing), this is done by an element specific for the component type, which related to the placement point.

attributes.name: identification
attributes.doc: Specifies a unique identification of the PlacementPoint. The identification is guaranteed to be unique within a component.

attributes.name: segmentDiameter
attributes.doc: Specifies the valid segment diameter range for which this PlacementPoint is suitable.

name: PlacementType
documentation: Defines the type for which a PlaceableElement can be used.

name: Dimension
documentation: A Dimension defines a measurement for the distance between two Locations. An acceptable tolerance can be specified additionally. If the Locations are not located on adjacent topology-elements it is possible to specify a Path for the dimension along which the measurement must be taken. The value for the Dimension is not specified as NumericalValue (which can define a Tolerance as well). This is because the "valueComponent" of the NumericalValue is mandatory. For Dimensions it shall be optional si

attributes.name: identification
attributes.doc: Specifies a unique identification of the Dimension. The identification is guaranteed to be unique within the containing PlacementSpecification.

attributes.name: valueComponent
attributes.doc: Defines the value of the dimension. This value can be null, if it shall be calculated and only a tolerance shall be defined.

attributes.name: valueCalculated
attributes.doc: Defines if the value of the Dimension was calculated (e.g. the sum of segment lengths in the topology) or if it was defined manually.

name: DimensionAnchor
documentation: A DimensionAnchor represents an abstract anchor onto which a Dimension can be specified.

name: MeasurementPointReference
documentation: A MeasurementPointReference is the instance of a MeasurementPoint in the context of an OccurrenceOrUsage .

attributes.name: identification
attributes.doc: Specifies a unique identification of the MeasurementPointReference. The identification is guaranteed to be unique within the containing PlaceableElementRole.

name: OnPointPlacement
documentation: An OnPointPlacement is a placement of an OccurrenceOrUsage that places it onto discrete points, in most cases one point. In some cases, it is necessary to place a component (with more than one reference point) onto multiple points (e.g. a cable duct).

name: OnWayPlacement
documentation: An OnWayPlacement places an OccurrenceOrUsage onto an area of the Topology (e.g. a tape or a tube). The area is defined by a startLocation and an endLocation. If startLocation and endLocation are not located on the same TopologySegment it is possible to specify a Path of TopologySegments over which the OnWayPlacement goes. The names start- and endLocation are used to distinguish between the two ends. It does not indicate a direction as property of the product (e.g. for tapes).

name: PlaceableElementRole
documentation: A PlaceableElementRole defines the instance specific properties and relationships of a PlaceableElement.

name: Placement
documentation: A placement defines the placement of a PlaceableElementRole onto a Topology. For the definition of the place on the Topology, Locations are used. A Placement can either be a placement on discrete points (OnPointPlacement) or on an area of the topology (OnWayPlacement).

attributes.name: identification
attributes.doc: Specifies a unique identification of the Location. The identification is guaranteed to be unique within the PlacementSpecification.

attributes.name: type
attributes.doc: Room to specify additional type information of the placement.

name: PlacementPointReference
documentation: A PlacementPointReference is the instance of a PlacementPoint in the context of an OccurrenceOrUsage .

attributes.name: identification
attributes.doc: Specifies a unique identification of the PlacementPointReference. The identification is guaranteed to be unique within the containing PlaceableElementRole.

name: PlacementSpecification
documentation: Specification for the description of placements. Placements are used to connect OccurrenceOrUsages with a topology.

name: DefaultDimension
documentation: A DefaultDimension defines a tolerance value that shall be applied to a part, if no explicit tolerance value has been defined.

attributes.name: dimensionValueRange
attributes.doc: dimensionValueRange defines the magnitude of measurements for which the tolerance applies (e.g. length from 500mm - 1500mm).

attributes.name: dimensionType
attributes.doc: The dimensionType defines to which measurements this DefaultDimension applies.

name: DefaultDimensionSpecification
documentation: A DefaultDimensionSpecification defines tolerances that shall be applied to a part, if no explicit tolerance value has been defined.

name: DefaultDimensionType
documentation: The dimensionType defines to which measurements this DefaultDimension applies.

name: Routing
documentation: A Routing is the assignment of a RoutableElement (Connection or WireElementReference) to a path in the topology.

attributes.name: identification
attributes.doc: Specifies a unique identification of the Routing. The identification is guaranteed to be unique within the RoutingSpecification.

attributes.name: specialRoutedComment
attributes.doc: Allows the specification of an explanation why this routing has been routed in a special way.

attributes.name: specialRouted
attributes.doc: Specifies that routing has been created in a special way. This means it has not been calculated in the standard way, because for some reason the result of the standard calculation has been inconvenien

name: RoutingSpecification
documentation: Specification for the description of Routings.

name: ComponentNode
documentation: A ComponentNode is a node where an electrological component is located. It is a representative for an element in the electric system, e.g. an actuator, a sensor, an ECU. In this way it is quite similar to a NetworkNode and may even reference the corresponding NetworkNode in this case. However, a ComponentNode is more likely to be used as a representative of an inliner or a splice. Moreover, a ComponentNode can define childNodes in order to describe its internal structure.

attributes.name: identification
attributes.doc: Specifies a unique identification of the ComponentNode. The identification is guaranteed to be unique within the ConnectionSpecification.

attributes.name: abbreviation
attributes.doc: Room for a short name of the ComponentNode.

attributes.name: componentNodeType
attributes.doc: Specifies the type of the ComponentNode.

attributes.name: description
attributes.doc: Room for additional, human readable information about the ComponentNode.

attributes.name: subType
attributes.doc: Specifies the sub type of a ComponentNode. The sub type allows a differentiation within a specific type. E.g. an actuator can be differentiated into lamps, speakers, motors.

name: ComponentPort
documentation: Defines a port of ComponentNode. A ComponentPort is usually the realization of a NetworkPort. Electrological connections are defined between two or more ComponentPorts.

attributes.name: identification
attributes.doc: Specifies a unique identification of the ComponentPort. The identification is guaranteed to be unique within the ComponentConnector.

attributes.name: aliasId
attributes.doc: Specifies additional identifiers for the element.

attributes.name: signalDirection
attributes.doc: Specifies the direction of the signal on this ComponentPort.

attributes.name: description
attributes.doc: Room for additional, human readable information about the ComponentPort.

name: Connection
documentation: A Connection is an electrological connection between two or more ComponentPorts.

attributes.name: identification
attributes.doc: Specifies a unique identification of the Connection. The identification is guaranteed to be unique within the ConnectionSpecification.

attributes.name: description
attributes.doc: Specifies additional, human readable information about the Connection.

attributes.name: installationInstruction
attributes.doc: Specifies installation instruction for the connection.

name: ConnectionEnd
documentation: A connection end is the end of a Connection at a ComponentPort.

attributes.name: identification
attributes.doc: Specifies a unique identification of the ConnectionEnd. The identification is guaranteed to be unique within the ConnectionSpecification.

attributes.name: isExternalEnd
attributes.doc: Specifies if the ConnectionEnd is connected to the internal or the external side of the ComponentPort.

attributes.name: gender
attributes.doc: Specifies if the ConnectionEnd is male or female. This may be e.g. important in case of an inliner.

attributes.name: installationInstruction
attributes.doc: Specifies installation instruction for the ConnectionEnd .

name: ConnectionGroup
documentation: A ConnectionGroup references two or more Connections expressing that the physical realization of the referenced Connection shall be somehow grouped e.g. twisted. For complex structures a ConnectionGroup can specify subgroups.

attributes.name: identification
attributes.doc: Specifies a unique identification of the ConnectionGroup. The identification is guaranteed to be unique within the ConnectionSpecification.

attributes.name: connectionGroupType
attributes.doc: Specifies the type of the connectionGroup, valid literals are defined in the open enumeration ConnectionGroupType .

attributes.name: installationInstruction
attributes.doc: Specifies additional InstallationInstructions for the ConnectionGroup.

attributes.name: description
attributes.doc: Room for additional, human readable information about the ConnectionGroup.

name: ConnectionSpecification
documentation: A ConnectionSpecification is used to define electrological connectivity.

name: ComponentConnector
documentation: A ComponentConnector is a grouping of ComponentPorts and represents a logical abstraction of a connector of an EEComponent . When the ComponentNode is realized by an EEComponentRole the ComponentConnector will result in a HousingComponent. It is permitted that a ComponentConnector is a 150% definition of connector.

attributes.name: identification
attributes.doc: Specifies a unique identification of the ComponentConnector. The identification is guaranteed to be unique within the ComponentNode.

name: ComponentNodeType
documentation: Defines the common agreed values for the types of a ComponentNode.

name: ConnectionGroupType
documentation: Defines the type of physical realization that is expressed by a ConnectionGroup.

name: ComponentNodeSubType
documentation: Defines agreed values for ComponentNodeSubTypes . Not all combinations of ComponentNodeSubTypes and ComponentNodeTypes are semantically correct (e.g. Lamp, Microphone, Speaker, Motor are all Actuators).

name: ConnectionEndGender
documentation: Defines the gender of a connection end.

name: ConnectionViewSpecification
documentation: The ConnectionViewSpecification supports the exchange of a basic layout for a ConnectionSpecification .

name: ComponentPortViewItem
documentation: A ComponentPortViewItem represents a ComponentPort within a ComponentNodeViewItem and defines its position on the node.

attributes.name: side
attributes.doc: Specifies the side of the ComponentNodeViewItem on which the port should be displayed.

name: ConnectionNodeViewItem
documentation: A ComponentNodeViewItem represents a ComponentNode within a ConnectionViewSpecification and defines its position within the layout.

attributes.name: identification
attributes.doc: Specifies a unique identification of the ComponentNodeViewItem . The identification is guaranteed to be unique within the ConnectionViewSpecification .

attributes.name: gridSquare
attributes.doc: Specifies the grid square in which the ComponentNodeViewIt em is placed (e.g. E/40).
